reason: With the system, the radiologists' area under the ROC curve rose from 0.8288 to 0.8654 and their sensitivity from 71% to 78%.
The reduction in missed cancers was estimated on past films that no radiologist read with the marks, so no gain at any screening site is measured.
Nine of 193 women had high-grade lesions found by LUMA-directed biopsies after colposcopy had missed them.
EPA estimated that two such systems at the mill would cost less than half as much a year as two continuous emission monitoring systems.
GAO found that lenders needed less documentation for accepted loans and that one scorecard gave consistent decisions, but it measured no time or cost saved.
GAO found that borrowers shared in the lighter paperwork, since lenders no longer had to obtain verification of rent for accepted loans.
EPA approved the software as Unit 3's NOx monitor and estimated that it would cost less than half as much a year as an analyzer.
EPA approved the software as the NOx monitor in place of hardware analyzers and estimated that it would cost less than half as much a year to run on Unit GTP1.
The validation used archived tumors from patients diagnosed before 1999, and the test guided no treatment.
Two probation officers each supervised about 400 people forecast as low risk with about 45 percent fewer contacts and no measured rise in reoffending.
People in the low-intensity caseloads reported in person once every six months, with no measured rise in rearrest.
Claimants in the sample got medical determinations in 18 days on average, and those allowed got them in 15 days on average.
The ANAO credits the group's methods with improved compliance, services and use of resources but gives no figure.
The study measured agreement with available diagnoses on processed specimens, and no change in diagnosis or treatment is reported.
The second high-school cohort had a measurable algebra gain, although the corrected significance test was inconclusive.
EPA approved the software as Unit 2's NOx monitor in place of the analyzer that GRE had meant to be temporary.
The NCAR authors report that forecast error at a typical wind farm fell from about 18% of capacity in 2008 to 10.8% in 2014, a measured gain in accuracy. The savings figures are Xcel's estimates.
Xcel estimated that better forecasts had saved customers US$49 million by October 2015, a cost saving. No audited figure exists.
Across the two studies, the improvement index for comprehension was +9 percentile points for 6,724 students.
The study measured agreement with manual microscopy, and no gain in time or accuracy at any laboratory is reported.
NRG has reported the eight turbines' NOx with the software since 2009 and 2011, after EPA found that it matched the analyzers.
The WWC found a statistically significant gain of 0.11 standard deviations on a standardized math test, an improvement index of +4 percentile points.
Dermatologists did not see the device results in the blinded study, so no biopsy decision changed because of it.
Patrols guided by the model saw an average 7.4 percent less crime volume per thousand patrol minutes than patrols guided by analysts.
The review had not run when the court ruled, so the opinion reports no saving for MSL or the plaintiffs.
The review had not run when the court ruled, and the cost and recall figures are the defendants' own estimates.
Matching detected identity frauds that the Passport Office would not otherwise have found, about 22 recorded a year, which the ANAO considers an undercount.
Fraudulently obtained passports can support other crimes, but the audit does not measure harm prevented beyond the detected cases.
EPA approved the models on a demonstration against the analyzers, and the letter reports no saving or other outcome for the cooperative.
Surgeons in the device arm achieved complete re-excision of positive margins in 71.8% of patients who had them, against 22.4% in the control arm.
Re-operations fell from 25.8% to 20.8%, a difference that was not statistically significant.
The court found that the algorithm-driven review reduced the work left for contract attorneys, but it measured no saving.
A patient with 48 years of treatment-resistant pain reached pain-free periods and regained phantom movement. The authors give no long-term follow-up, so a lasting effect is not established.

The case report describes one patient. The same group later reported a trial in 14 patients and a randomized trial in 81 patients, and in the randomized trial the authors found no evidence that the decoded execution was superior to guided motor imagery. No realized outcome across a population is documented.
Biomet's finished review met its discovery obligations, so it did not have to pay for a restart that the court put in the low seven figures.
The identifications were checked against sequencing, and no change in time to result or treatment is reported.
Users gained more than peers in silent reading on standardized reading tests, with improvement indexes of 27 for literacy and 38 for basic skills.
Participating homes used 781 kWh less electricity a year, 4.7% of their total use.
Electricity use for heating in the pilot homes fell by 12% of heating load.
The reviewers found that accuracy averaged 98.5%, a considerable improvement on their 2012 analysis, but that long delays caused omissions and misreporting.
U.S. sellers sold more to Spanish-speaking buyers after translation.
Exports on eBay to Spanish-speaking Latin America rose by 10.9% in the published estimate and 17.5% to 20.9% in the working paper.
The review had not run when the court ruled, and the order states no saving.
Every participant also had a colonoscopy, so the test changed no screening decision in the study.

Only a retrospective simulation is documented. In it, 69% of the establishments with critical violations would have been found in the first half of the work, against 55% in the normal order. No outcome of live use that can be credited to the model is documented.
The city gives earlier discovery of violations as the rationale, since discovery otherwise may come “potentially after patrons became ill”. No outcome for illness is documented.
The review had not run when the court ruled, and the costs are the taxpayers' expert's estimates.
Physicians did not see the device output, so no CT scan was avoided in the study. FDA's figure of 29% rests on assumptions.

The report records reviews of around 100 customer relationships. It also records a third linked company whose review revealed potential money laundering concerns. The losses avoided are an estimate, and no observed figure for them appears in the report.
The statement in the foreword about neutralizing networks of mule accounts is general, and the authors tie it to no documented outcome.

Borrowers with subprime FICO scores who received better grades paid less for credit, and LendingClub borrowers paid smaller spreads than credit card borrowers with the same default risk. The authors report a cost saving, measured across loan vintages.
Financial-inclusion effects are discussed at the aggregate level only.

The Medicare program saved money through denied claims, payment suspensions and referred overpayments. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services count $654.8 million identified or prevented in 2015. They reported to the Government Accountability Office that the system's edits denied nearly 169,000 claims and saved $11.3 million in fiscal 2015. These are cost savings for the Medicare program.
Savings to the Medicare program are stated only as yearly totals that mix denied claims with projected avoidance, and no source traces an effect on beneficiaries or taxpayers.
Kiribati secured a US$1 million fine and a US$1 million goodwill grant, a measurable result, and no source reports a lasting change or a risk removed.
The 2018 study found that fishing in the protected area fell to nearly zero after the closure, but it does not discuss the Marshalls 203 fine, so no source ties that fall to the platform.
The program's identity-theft models were the only system to select $1.88 billion of the $3.92 billion in confirmed identity-theft refunds in the 2015 filing season.
The IRS reports, through GAO, that the program prevented more than $6.51 billion in invalid refunds from January 2015 to November 2017.
Homes with a Nest used about 34 therms less gas a year, about 6% of their heating load.
Gas use for heating fell by about 6% in the homes with a Nest.
The review had not run when the court approved the protocol, so the opinion reports no saving or accuracy for either company.
The review had not run when the court ruled, and the saving rests on sworn estimates that the parties' experts disputed.

In 142 blinded inspections the nEmesis arm found 9 versus 6 demerits per inspection (p = 0.019). It found 11 versus 7 venues graded C or worse, an unpermitted seafood establishment and a sick food handler.

The 71 infections and 4.4 hospitalizations said to be saved are the authors' estimates from outbreak averages of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop in foodborne-illness investigations from 11 to 5 comes from an uncontrolled comparison with the year before, so no prevented illness is measured.

Participants showed measured gains in their scores on reading and daily tasks. In the 2015 study, 12 patients went from 2.5 to 9.5 of 10 tasks with the device. These are test results, and no lasting change in a person's life is reported. In the Dutch study only three of 20 patients kept using the device.
The authors tested usability in cohorts at several sites and report no societal outcome that can be attributed to the devices.
83% of occupants reported more satisfaction with their thermal environment, a gain in comfort.
Hot and cold calls to maintenance fell by 59% over the three-month test, which saved staff time.
The energy savings were modeled for prototype buildings and were not metered.
The study measured a statistical effect across subscribed areas, and no single event can be credited to a person.
The study measured the effect at the level of subscribed administrative areas and concessions.

The study measured an 18 percent drop in the probability of deforestation in African areas with subscribers, compared with 2011 to 2016 levels. That is a measured improvement in a result. The authors priced the avoided emissions as an estimate, and they found no effect on other continents.
Residents had hazardous service lines found and replaced, though no study in the sources measures a health effect that can be credited to the model.
The program gained a measured capability to predict pipe materials and prioritize work.

Flint replaced hazardous service lines at 4,419 homes by September 2017. In July 2025 the Natural Resources Defense Council said that nearly 11,000 pipes had been replaced. The model helped prioritize inspections for part of that period.
Tailgating alerts in the fitted cabs fell from 100 to between 20 and 40 per 100 miles, a measured change in how closely drivers followed.
Crash rates for the vehicles in the trial did not show a clear decline, so no gain in road safety is shown.
Students had measurable gains in math and Hindi.
The review had not run when the court approved it, so the judgment reports no measured saving.

The authors report named proband outcomes. A diagnosis of CTPS1 deficiency in a 10-year-old girl, admitted to intensive care with life-threatening chicken pox after a seven-year diagnostic odyssey, enabled a curative bone marrow transplantation. A diagnosis of transcobalamin II deficiency, made after a male neonate died at four months with no diagnosis, let his younger brother start weekly hydroxocobalamin injections that prevent metabolic decompensation. The authors do not say whether Exomiser or the applied panels found either variant, so the depth rests on the pilot's reported outcomes without an attribution to the software.

The virtual panel pipeline alone made 322 of the 490 diagnoses that came from single-nucleotide variants or indels, and the panels together with Exomiser's top five candidates made 92% of them. That is a measurable gain in what the diagnostic pipeline could find.
A 25% diagnostic yield across 2,183 families is reported for a national pilot. No change across the population is documented.
The participant regained a lasting ability to communicate at home. The Utrecht team has not shown that it prevented a separate serious harm.
The disclosure had not been made when the court ruled, and the costs are the respondents' lawyers' estimates.

Children in the trial's device group gained 4.58 points more on the parent-reported Vineland socialization subscale than controls, a measured improvement in a test score. Spectrum reported that the gain had disappeared six weeks after treatment ended, so no lasting change is documented.
The device was used only in research cohorts, and no source reports a change across a population.
The taxpayers met the request with a set that the model chose from about 406,000 documents, and the order states no time or cost saved.
More already-committed students completed college enrollment.
Households just eligible for loans were 6.3 percentage points less likely to forgo expenses after a shock, a measured gain in resilience near the cutoff.

McGrath was unresponsive and not breathing during a seizure when the device alerted her mother, who called paramedics. IEEE Spectrum reports that she is alive and well thanks to the timely response, which is a life preserved. The account rests on that single news report.
Radiologists saved 71 seconds per case, a third of their reading time, with accuracy that met the non-inferiority margin.
The review had not run, and the judgment gives no time or cost for the review with TAR.
The authors report cross-validated accuracy of classification (95.6%) on 185 children. They report nothing on what followed for any child.
No individual beneficiary is identified in the sources.

The outcome is material to DNIT and TCU. Inforchannel and JOTA report that an acórdão blocked or canceled the tenders, and the July 2018 visit report reproduces the order to annul notices 88/2017 and 102/2017. Inforchannel gives R$39 million for two notices, and JOTA gives R$20 million for one.
This is a single highway tender among some 60,000 federal tenders a year, small at national scale.
ISF measured errors in 55% of the claims that the model picked, against 34% of claims checked at random.
Roughly 24 more children each month were screened in accurately after the tool was introduced.
Each opted-in thermostat saved about 18 therms of gas heating over the winter.
Opted-in homes with gas furnaces together saved 110,404 therms over the winter.
EyeArt ran in parallel with usual care, so no grader's workload changed during the study.
In the first semester, 34.30% of students placed by the algorithms completed a college-level English course, against 28.00% of students placed by the standard procedure.
The evaluators list the tool among the project's efficiency measures but give no figure for what it changed in prices, review costs or services, so the extent cannot be established.
A defendant released at the first appearance avoids weeks and months in jail while presumed innocent, which the acting administrative director of the courts calls a life-changing consequence avoided.
Statewide, detention after the detention hearing fell to 7.3% of people charged with indictable offenses against a predicted 21.9%, and the jail population kept falling through 2019.

Of 132 inspections that FINDER prompted, 69 (52.3%) found an unsafe restaurant, against 2,662 of 10,786 (24.7%) baseline inspections. Adjusted for city and risk level, the odds ratio was 3.06 (95% confidence interval 2.14–4.35).
The authors write that corrective actions “would prevent” spread of foodborne illness, and they document no reduction in illness.
The 2021 study reports changes for cohorts of veterans. No individual veteran's outcome is documented, and mortality did not differ in 2021 or 2025.

VA authors report measurable gains in care. Completed outpatient visits and new safety plans rose for identified veterans, and care evaluations rose from 46.1% to 87.5% of them between March 2017 and December 2018.

VA's own evaluators report fewer documented suicide attempts, mental health admissions and emergency visits among 40,816 veterans at top risk. It found no change in suicide or all-cause deaths, so no lives saved are documented.
Radiologists saved an average of 19.6 seconds per case, with accuracy that met the non-inferiority goal.
No outcome for a foreign patient has been documented. Only the crews' views, the app's capability and its rollout have been described.

In the Sapporo Fire Bureau's survey, more than 70% of ambulance crews said that the app made communication with foreign patients faster and better than existing methods. The crews themselves reported the time saving.

The developers report that in one pilot week police in Murcia and Málaga detected and closed 25 and 39 false robbery reports. In June of the years 2008 to 2016 the two cities had averaged 3.33 and 12.14 per month. That is a measured gain in a police result. The developers ran the pilot themselves, and researchers with no tie to the project note that the paper's authors give no case counts or confusion matrix.
No source measures any effect on insurance fraud, on police workload or on people wrongly flagged.
No outcome for the more than 7.5 million children targeted is on record in the sources. Any benefit to them is indirect and unmeasured.
The Red Cross reports that the mapping area fell from 94,080 km² to 2,745 km². It reports that volunteers completed the base map in a fraction of the normal time.
The maps played a supporting role in one national campaign. No measured effect of the maps on vaccination coverage appears in the sources.

One man with tetraplegia used his brain signals to control a walking simulation and arm movements with eight degrees of freedom, with the avatar at home and the exoskeleton in the laboratory. The control did not give him everyday mobility.
The study involved one participant, and no source reports an effect across a population.
Dermatologists' sensitivity rose from 77.2% to 83.6% only in a reader study of 141 stored images, and in the pivotal study they were blinded to the device, so care did not depend on it.
Camera operators with no earlier imaging experience obtained a screening result for 96.1% of graded participants, and the software found 87.4% of people with more than mild retinopathy.
FDA reviewers describe wider access to retinopathy screening in primary care as a potential benefit, and no realized effect on access or vision across the population is reported.
KYield names no client and reports no prevented event.
No prevented catastrophe or measured reduction in losses has been reported.
Radiologist AUC rose from 0.7055 to 0.7575 with the score in the reader study.
Face matching let DHS confirm 105,000 nonimmigrant departures from U.S. airports in 2017, nearly 1,300 of them visa overstays.
The study measured agreement with manual microscopy, and no gain in time or accuracy at any laboratory is reported.
The crash rate was lower than for human drivers, but the difference was not statistically significant and employees supervised the cars.
Audits of the claims that SARS identified cut refund credits by 34,776,054,832 rand, or 17.38%, in the 2017 financial year.
Only OPTiM's announcement exists. No trial result, alert count or staffing effect was published.
No passenger safety outcome is documented.
Participants moved three clothespins in 90.2 seconds with pattern recognition against 137 seconds with direct control, and seven of eight preferred it.
The court found that the City's TAR review was reliable and let it keep using the system for its remaining review.

NASA's Paul Hertz said that discoveries were lurking in archived Kepler data awaiting the right tool. The archive yielded two newly validated planets without new telescope observations by the authors. Their validation used Kepler data and follow-up observations that other observers had already uploaded to the Kepler Community Follow-up Program.
Astronomy gained a validated eighth planet and the first exoplanetary system known to have eight planets, tying the Solar System. The gain is knowledge for a specialist community of astronomers.

About 74% of the staff who answered the survey found Insight useful and valuable in reviewing decisions. The Inspector General could not determine whether it improved decisions in the hearing offices.
The Cour gives the 2018 share of irregular files but no share from before the model, so the size of the gain cannot be established.
Audits of very small firms picked by data mining reassessed 12.6% of the contributions audited in 2018, against 6.1% across all such audits.
The 51-minute difference comes from a retrospective test on past scans in which no alert reached a specialist, so no realized gain for the sites is reported.

The Delhi Police have not documented a child reunited with a family as a result of the 2,930 matches. The High Court recorded on 22 January 2019 that the software had not cracked any missing-child case.
The police reported 2,930 identities “established” to the ministry. The same police told the court four months later that the software produced only a two percent match.
The court's own figures (5,160 children untraced of 19,916 reported in 2016–2018) are the context. No reduction attributable to the software is documented.

Dexcom's authors report that time below 54 mg/dL fell from 1.0% to 0.6% for G6 users in their own analysis. The authors of the one independent randomized trial of the alert found a difference only below 2.8 mmol/L. Neither set of authors credits the alert with averting a specific serious event.
No outcome for a payer, clinic or health system is reported.
Aided clinicians reached 80.3% sensitivity and 91.4% specificity against 74.7% and 88.9% unaided.
The sources include neither an outcome for farmers nor a figure for how accurately the app detects fall armyworm.
The Food and Agriculture Organization planned to feed Nuru's reports into its monitoring system, and the sources do not show that it did.
Patients waited 33.1 fewer minutes on average in the presurgical area.
Mean absolute error of planned case duration fell from 59.3 to 49.5 minutes.

McClure et al. report that eagle fatalities at the treatment site fell by 63% after automated curtailment, a measurable improvement in a conservation result. They state that deaths were not eliminated. Two U.S. Geological Survey statisticians reanalyzed the data and put the effect at 50%, with an interval that includes an increase, so the size of the effect is disputed.
No outcome for the operator, such as a permit, a cost or a legal risk avoided, is documented in the sources.
An attempt to enter the United States on another person's genuine passport was stopped and the traveler removed. No further threat beyond the document fraud is documented.

CBP gained a verified first detection for a system then three days into use at Dulles, and in later releases it reports repeated catches. Gizmodo reported that CBP's annual report for fiscal year 2020 showed no impostor flagged at any airport that year.
In the study, 86.3% of participants were correctly predicted as responders and given a jaw position that worked.
Residents spent 29.6 fewer minutes on the ground after falls, and lies of more than an hour fell from 31% of fallers to none.
Time until staff assistance fell by 28.3 minutes between the baseline and real-time notification periods.

The authors report sensitivity, time to recognition and recognition rates across the trial. None of them traces a changed outcome to a single patient. The randomized trial found no significant improvement in how often dispatchers recognized arrests.
The authors report a study of the model's ability and a randomized trial that found no significant effect. They do not document an event in the dispatch center with an observed outcome.
Arisat's reported rise from 0.5 kg to 2.0 to 5.0 kg per plant is a measurable improvement in her harvest. The figures come only from the developer's blog.

Operators confirmed system matches in 333 of 1,524 searches with the newer algorithm, and the report relays a count of over 100 people charged, with no comparison against investigations without the system.
The report gives no outcome for the charges and no count of crimes solved or prevented.
Breakthrough Listen recovered 72 more bursts from an existing dataset of 400 terabytes from Green Bank, with no new time on the telescope.
Researchers who study fast radio bursts gained a much larger sample (93 pulses in five hours) from the only repeating burst known at the time.
Viz.ai data showed a median of 4.31 minutes from scan to specialist notification across 4,763 patients in routine use.
Three hospitals reported average reductions in door-to-puncture time of 24, 30 and 44 minutes for thrombectomy patients.
Drivers stand to gain from steady lane centering, but Consumer Reports rated behavior in tests and reports no crash outcome.
Lay users' results matched a reference analyzer in a study at evaluation sites, and no use at home is reported.
The rangers removed over one thousand snares in a month, where they had reported two or three hundred before. A chi-squared test confirmed that the predictions told high risk from low (p = 0.023).

Over one thousand snares were removed from a sanctuary that is identified as a site for reintroducing tigers. The authors state that each snare “represents the life of one animal potentially saved”. No change in an animal population is documented in the sources.
The test met neither accuracy goal, and the study did not measure whether it changed any diagnosis.

Althingi replaced the first, manual stage of transcription with automatic drafts. Its transcribers graded 77% of the transcripts as Good, and about 640 hours of speeches had been transcribed by November 2019.

Vísir reported on 4 March 2018 that the recognizer was released under an open-source license. The sources do not show that anyone outside Althingi used it or that the public gained a measured result from it.
Participants regained sustained control of everyday computer tasks at home. No separate societal outcome was measured.

A biopsy-confirmed stage 1A melanoma was excised, further tests found no spread and he is reported cancer-free. He calls it life-saving, but stage 1A is early disease and no clinician is quoted on prognosis. How long he would otherwise have waited is his own estimate.
The figures cover the whole program, and no single person's case is reported.
The council reports that it saved over £1m on 5,145 pothole repairs. It reports that its payouts on pothole claims fell from £1.6m in 2008/09 to £719. Both are savings in cost.
The figures are local totals with no single event to credit. Complaints about potholes rose in 2023 to 2025.
The team tested necrosis detection on university servers with limited data. No improvement in clinical work is documented.
No diagnosis or treatment outcome for a patient is documented.
Desk checks picked by the score found overpayments in 26% of files in 2019 against 6% in 2012, and data mining detected €218.5 million of overpayments that year.
The checks found €87.2 million in arrears owed to beneficiaries in 2019, but the Cour gives neither the number of households nor what each received.
Students who received the outreach were about two to three percentage points more likely to file the FAFSA by the end of spring.
The 21 drivers triggered 30 to 70% fewer forward collision, lane departure and headway warnings, a measured change in how they drove.
By the agency's preliminary results, checks of 74 companies that the model flagged had a hit rate of 47% in the control's first year.
The checks brought in DKK 5.3 million for the state by the end of 2019, a preliminary figure.
Carf's panels decided more appeals than arrived in 2019, but the TCU offers the AI batching only as one possible explanation and gives no figure for its part.
The evaluation relays only that ALIA datasets were used in one vulnerability analysis and does not say what they changed.
Students in treatment schools scored 0.22 standard deviations higher in math and 0.20 higher in Hindi after 18 months.
The authors estimate a 50 to 66 percent increase in the productivity of school time. J-PAL reports that the in-school model was twice as cost-effective as the earlier after-school model.
Median time in hypotension per patient fell from 32.7 to 8.0 minutes during surgery.
Every type of warning fell after drivers began receiving alerts, by 34.17% on average for similar dates, a measured change in how the buses were driven.
The study counted warnings, and the report gives no crash figures for the test, so no gain in road safety is shown.

A woman with a recent transient ischemic attack received a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation on an electrocardiogram, with rate control and an anticoagulant. Later case reports describe deeper benefits, such as ablation with a defibrillator for ventricular tachycardia and a pacemaker for heart block. This rating covers the woman's case alone.

For the first time, a paralyzed man's attempts to speak were decoded as whole words, about three times faster than he could type with a pointer. The decoding used a vocabulary of 50 words in research sessions.
Thorn's chief executive said that a child sold for weeks was recovered and removed from trauma. The sources hold no confirmation of the recovery from anyone outside Thorn.
The contractors expect that patients will be spared surgical lung biopsy, but no cited study counted biopsies avoided or measured patient outcomes.
The machine-learning score separated defaults better than bureau scores, with an AUROC of 0.76 against 0.64 and 0.68.
About 30% of the loan portfolio went to merchants that the bureau rated high risk, whom the authors describe as otherwise excluded from credit.
The assay tested archived swabs against a cleared assay, and no diagnosis or treatment depended on its results.
Nurses with no echocardiography experience produced exams that cardiologists judged sufficient to assess left ventricular size in 98.8% of patients.
FDA reviewers expect that patients would gain faster access to echocardiography, and no outcome beyond the two-site study has been reported.
The test measured 98% correct matches and 0.0092% false matches, which lets CBP record departures as biometrically confirmed.
Inspectors found errors in 34% of the VAT refund returns that the model selected, against 17% under the old selection rules.
The €60 million a year in extra revenue is the Belastingdienst's own estimate, with no results yet from measuring extra revenue in practice.
No individual outcome is documented.

Patrollers in Sirukam say that alerts let them go straight to a chainsaw's location, and local monitors told Reuters that the system made their work easier. The gain is speed of response. The one dated interception, in August 2019, ended with the logger escaping.

A patroller told Reuters that logging in the Sirukam area had stopped. Reuters also credits a wider enforcement crackdown, and a former logger quit in 2018, before the sensors, so the sources do not show that the alerts caused the change.
People in the Model 3 stand to gain, but ANCAP reports test scores and no crash outcomes.
Pedestrians, cyclists and people in other vehicles stand to gain, but ANCAP reports test scores and no crash outcomes.

Applicants with low credit scores who would have failed a traditional model got loans at lower rates. The authors of a 2026 peer-reviewed study report that their later finances improved. The effects are measured across Upstart's applicants as a group.
Researchers and the monitor describe effects on access across all applicants and later disparities. No outcome for society has been measured.
South Wales Police made arrests or disposals in 37 cases where existing methods had not located the person, by the court's account of its evidence.
The judgment does not say what the 37 people were wanted for, so the effect on public safety cannot be established.

An injured hiker stranded on a ledge at night was located and brought out the same night. Injuries are reported inconsistently (fractured back per NBC News, fractured hand per ABC7). Whether he could have called 911 himself is not addressed.
Middletown police say that three agencies responded to the automated call. The police do not report time or resources saved for any of them.
No patient-management or clinical outcome was measured.
Laboratory-level accuracy was measured under study conditions, and the authors did not evaluate routine field operation.
No deployment at program scale is documented.
Senior students in schools with either version of the system scored 0.094 standard deviations higher on the ENEM essay than students in comparison schools.
The authors report that teachers moved time from routine grading toward individual discussions with students about essay quality.
Patients in the GI Genius arm had at least one adenoma found in 55.1% of procedures against 42.0% in the standard arm.
Endoscopists found 0.81 adenomas per colonoscopy with the program against 0.57 without it.
The gains were measured in retrospective simulations on three completed reviews, and no review team relied on the predictions in live work.
The 14 children came to light through reports by neighbors and others after the rule had kept them from home visits.
In its re-run the board found that the model ranked children later found abused above others, but the ministry's rule kept those children from visits.
Job finding across all contracts showed no statistically significant change, and the 1% rise in short-term hiring had a p-value of 0.09.
Most people assessed got a release recommendation, 88% from 2021 to 2023, at rates that barely differed by race, a measurable improvement in the advice that judges receive about them.
Across the city the spread in recommendation rates between racial groups was cut in half on the development data, from 9.4 to 4.3 percentage points.
Median time to TB treatment fell from 11 days under standard care to 1 day in the X-ray arm. In that arm, 6 of 15 TB patients started treatment on the day of the visit.
Low-skilled drivers found customers with 7% less cruising time, and drivers are paid a share of fares.
Drivers stand to gain from fewer fatigue and distraction events, but the report rests on interviews and gives no measured event or crash rates.
Operators said that the alerts gave them more certain information for managing fatigue, but the report gives no measure of the effect.
Police and EMS response and transport times were shorter in shootings that activated ShotSpotter, with p < 0.05 for each comparison.
Gunshot victims reached the trauma center sooner, and mortality adjusted for injury severity did not differ between the groups.
The models flagged 67 of the 244 well-rated banks that were later downgraded, which gave supervisors early notice of about a quarter of them.
Farmers scored 18–31% on diagnosis. The authors report only a “slight increase” in extension workers' skill after two weeks and no outcome for yield or income.
No deployment outcome for extension services is documented beyond the accuracy comparison.
Taxpayers who corrected claims are not individually documented. Beyond the total count of prompts, no individual outcome is given.
The ATO estimates the revenue impact of one tax time at about $37 million. The estimate has no independent check in the sources and no comparison with total collections.
The prompts protect public revenue at modest scale. They reached 7.5% of myTax users, and the stated impact is an estimate.
Citizens could put COVID-19 questions to the chatbot on over 76 government webpages.
The chatbot answered over 164,900 chats in four months for a government whose hotline was blocked, though no effect on the hotline is measured.
Children in screened-in episodes were 2.7 percentage points less likely to be removed from home within 180 days.
EPA reports that inspectors using the model found severe violations substantially more efficiently than with status quo targeting, at no extra operating cost.
No source measures pollution or harm avoided through the violations found.
CMDE judged that diagnosis improves over CT angiography, and the report gives no figures from the maker's trials.
CMDE judged that patients can be spared unnecessary invasive angiography and coronary intervention, and the report gives no count of procedures avoided.
Trial patients spent more time in the target range, but HbA1c did not change, and HAS judged that the long-term gain is still expected.
The patient learned from her watch, and had confirmed by Holter, that her rhythm had reverted at 19:29. The report records no change in management, so the benefit is informational only.
Both cars stopped so that the oak hit the bonnets, not the cabins, and all eight occupants walked away with bruises at worst. That is a serious harm averted in time.

Researchers have reported results in bacterial cultures and in mice, and independent laboratories have confirmed them. No outcome outside the laboratory, such as a treated patient or an approved drug, appears in the sources.

FAO states that East African control operations prevented the loss of 4 million tonnes of cereal and 800 million liters of milk. FAO says that they protected the food security of 36.6 million people. The Times quotes FAO's estimate of USD 1.5 billion averted since February 2020. These are estimates for the whole operation, and the AI's handling of data was one part of it.

FAO received up to 2,500 records a day with nearly 25 percent unusable. PlantVillage's AI removed the unwanted data. Over 240,000 records were collected in a year from scouts and citizens who could not have used the discontinued eLocust3 tablets.
No outcome for an individual farmer is documented.

By his account and by descriptions of the footage, the car moved one driver out of the path of a wrong-way car at about 60 mph before he reacted. The other driver also swerved onto the median, so the sources do not show whether they would have collided. No avoided injury or damage can be measured.

Thirteen patients had early, resectable lung cancer diagnosed and operated on. Seven were stage I and needed no further treatment. A survival benefit is plausible, but the authors do not demonstrate one.
The authors report that eight patients saw a pulmonologist on the day of the radiograph, before the formal report, which shortened the path to diagnosis.
Only results from a simulation exist, and no outcome in live operation is documented.
No collision avoided or reduced is documented.
No mariner is reported to have been helped.
The study analyzed 7,651 patients who received real-time grading with accuracy similar to that of retina specialists, and 2,412 of them were referred.
Primary-care sites received results in real time. MIT Technology Review reported that the system sped screening when it worked, and it also reported image rejections and connectivity problems.
Google and Thailand's Ministry of Public Health report no outcome for vision across the population.

The vendor reports that the system flagged a passenger staggering at the platform edge at Kyōdō on 3 April 2020 and that staff acted quickly to prevent an accident. The vendor calls it a prevented fall in its heading, and the sources do not show that a train was near, so the rating records a risk removed. The account comes only from the vendor.
The vendor reports that station staff felt more reassured, but it gives no count of alerts, false alarms or staff time.
Spirit reported that its review identified 85% of the responsive documents, and the court held that the review met its discovery obligations.
IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and led to removal of 7,853 illegal wildlife postings.
Removed listings are reported, but the extent of prevented transactions or protected wildlife is unknown.
Musst gave disclosure from 175,723 documents with technology assisted review, and the court let it stand on an estimated cost that the judgment does not state.
The service had not yet captioned users' calls when the FCC ruled, so the gain is a test result.

In 2018 the winning algorithm's compartment produced 6% more sellable cucumber than the growers' compartment. In 2020 every compartment run by an algorithm reached a higher net profit than the reference. These are measured results in experimental compartments, and no grower's own accounts are reported.
Differences in resource use are reported per compartment, and no wider outcome is documented.

One driver kept control of his car after swerving around a wild boar at 4 a.m. and arrived unhurt. By his account the car straightened the swerve he had begun. Whether he would have lost control or struck the animal without that correction is unknown. No avoided injury or damage is measured, so a removed risk is not established.
The device output was hidden from the clinicians, so no site gained a diagnosis that it would otherwise have missed or delayed.
The FCC certified the service on lab tests and beta comments, and no outcome for users in service is reported.

Doctors eliminated her bypass tract by catheter ablation 11 days after the band recorded 188 beats per minute. That removed the pathway behind her tachycardia, a risk removed. The band readings supported the referral.
The authors document no use of the predictions by the Food and Agriculture Organization, the Desert Locust Control Organization for Eastern Africa or national control centers.
No field outcome is reported.
No litigant outcome is documented.
The claim about processing time is the developers' statement at launch. The court has given no measure of a change in its work since the system came into use.
No effect on the quality or timeliness of tutela selection is documented.
The report gives no figures from the maker's pre-market trials and no result from use after approval.
The report gives no figures from the maker's pre-market trial and does not say that the software's advice guided care.
One man received a diagnosis of severe obstructive sleep apnea (3% ODI 33.6/h) from an incidental wearable signal. The authors report no treatment or follow-up for him.
The 80% sensitivity for predicting exacerbation is a retrospective pilot result on five events, which the authors say is too small to generalize. No live alerting or changed care is documented.
The test measured the system's reliability at one site, and the report gives no inspection or safety result for the railroad from its output.
The department reports that the model's accuracy in predicting dropout rose from 75% in 2017-18 to 92% in 2018-19.
The reviewers could not establish whether the mentoring reduced dropout, because the pilot was only then concluding.
The authors report associations across the cohort for mortality, organ failure and length of stay. No single patient's outcome can be traced to the system.
The authors report adjusted associations across 590,736 monitored patients. They describe no single event across the population.
No individual outcome is documented.
Shipping companies' cooperation grades are published, and no change due to Whale Safe is documented.
No avoided strike or population effect is documented.
The review had not run when the court ruled, and the order states no measured accuracy, time or cost.
Euro NCAP measured the system on test tracks, and no crash outcome for drivers or passengers is reported.
The study measured agreement with manual microscopy, and no gain in time or accuracy at any laboratory is reported.

A child separated from his parents for five years, living in an institution in another state, was identified and returned to his family. The police said that the match had “changed the lives of the child and his parents”.
The trial measured accuracy on stored images, it did not time the reading and the report gives no result from use after approval.
Drivers stand to gain from a system that holds the car in the center of its lane, but Consumer Reports rated behavior in tests and reports no crash outcome.
Novice and low-skilled agents resolved 34% more issues per hour in the working paper estimate. Attrition among agents with under six months of tenure fell by about 10 percentage points.
The firm's agents resolved 15% more issues per hour on average after gaining access.

Each of 138,531 rural beneficiaries received five mobile-money installments of 8,170 CFA (women) or 7,000 CFA (men), according to Table 1 of the World Bank study. The developers' randomized trial reports gains in food security, mental health and self-perceived economic status. A beneficiary told NPR that he paid school fees with the money.
The Government of Togo delivered shock-responsive rural assistance without a social registry. The World Bank documents the model as a reusable case study.
The program reached 138,531 rural beneficiaries. The authors of the Nature evaluation report that exclusion errors were 4 to 21 percent lower than with geographic targeting.
The ministry approved the car after a conformity examination, and no outcome for drivers is reported.
The report gives no figures for accuracy or reading time from the maker's pre-market trial and no result from use after approval.
No litigant outcome is documented.

The STF reports that every electronic appeal has been converted to searchable text on the day of receipt since December 2020, more than 10 million pages by May 2021. That is a convenience for staff. The STF reports no measured time saving, and the classifier was not in production.
No effect on case backlog or on litigants is documented.
More people with arrhythmias were diagnosed with 14-day Zio XT monitoring than with 24-hour Holter monitoring.
The authors report the classifier's accuracy (80.6% recall) and total use (over 200,000 people). They do not report what followed a screening result for any child.
No outcome is documented for the 60 participating schools or the other organizations beyond supplying participants.
Beta users could choose captions with no person listening, and they gave four or five stars to 84% of more than 11,000 automatic calls.
One man regained standing and walking, stairs included, and used the device at home on his own after ten years of paralysis. Part of the recovery remains when the device is off.
The TCU reports an annual total for the program, and no source reports an outcome for any person.
The R$426 million is an annual total of control benefits that the TCU credits to Alice, and the sources show no verified event behind it.

The TCU reports R$426 million in public funds captured in 2021 through control actions supported by Alice, a cost saved for the public purse under its own measurement method. No change beyond that saving appears in the TCU's report or elsewhere in the sources.

Households in selected wards were beneficiaries of the government's COVID-19 cash transfer. The PNAS authors say that disbursement began in mid-January 2021. In its status report, the World Bank records 49,000 beneficiary households as of 15 October 2021 without saying how many had been paid.

The National Social Safety Nets Coordinating Office stood up an urban registry within months through self-registration by mobile phone in the wards selected with the poverty map. In its appraisal document of November 2021, the World Bank reports over 1.75 million registrations.

The 1,163 selected wards, with over 20 million residents, were made eligible, and the 61.7% cut in inclusion errors is an estimate from a simulation. Neither the researchers nor the Nigerian government reports a realized change across that population.

The authors report that her phantom limb pain fell from 5 to 3 and that her stump pain fell from 6 to 0. Pain no longer interfered with her sleep. Her score on the EQ-5D-5L quality-of-life index rose from 0.23 to 0.63, and she had used the hand daily for more than three years. Karin says that the research “has given me a better life” and that she needs much less medication. The life of one person changed, and the evidence comes from a study of her alone, with no control group.
The discrepancy rate between emergency and radiology readings fell by 17% after the tool began.
Mean length of stay in the emergency department fell by 9 minutes.
The auditor reports a higher hit rate and more kroner uncovered per control when the model picks the returns.
Controls picked by the model had a tax effect of 309 million kroner in 2021, but the auditor gives no figure for controls picked without the model.
GAO reports that SHIPS gave the best intensity guidance of 48 models for Pacific hurricanes at longer lead times in 2021, and NHC forecasters use that guidance.
No source links the guidance to changes in NHC's warnings or to outcomes for people in the storms' paths.
The platform detected 85% of test fires within 10 minutes of visible smoke, and its alerting accuracy rate across more than 50 alerts to the utilities was above 90%.
The report names one fire that the platform flagged before it was reported to first responders but gives no outcome for that fire or any other.
The sources do not show that anyone received or acted on an alert.
No evaluation of the forecasts' accuracy and no figure for crop losses avoided appear in the sources.

A translator in Nunavik reports using Google Translate or Microsoft Translator to look up uncommon words and to proofread, and finding them helpful for quick translations. That is a convenience at work, and officials and presenters have reported errors that need a fluent reviewer.
The Government of Nunavut's and Microsoft's stated uses (healthcare communication, Office email, compliance with language law) are expectations without reported data.
Officials assert effects on the vitality of the language. VICE notes that Inuktut use fell from 72 to 65 percent between 2001 and 2016, and it makes no link to the tool.
No pedestrian was shown at risk, and no object fell. The only documented trigger was a reporter's test, so no outcome is documented.

Jiefang Daily reports 995 door/window alerts handled from January to May 2021. An official said that visitors trying the devices triggered more than 80% of all handled events and that real events were far fewer. Huangpu District's operations center has published no measure of efficiency.
The savings come from economic models of other countries' programs, and INESSS judged that they may not transfer to Québec.
The Inquiry does not report what shielding advice or support changed for the 1.7 million people added.
England's shielding list grew by 1.7 million people, with a larger share of non-white people than the adult population.
Fewer patients died with baricitinib than with placebo or usual care in COV-BARRIER and RECOVERY, where 28-day mortality was 12% with the drug and 14% without it.
The sources report a median recovery of 7 versus 8 days in ACTT-2 and a modeled cost estimate, but no saving that any hospital realized.
WHO strongly recommended baricitinib and the FDA approved it, but the sources do not measure uptake or lives saved across a population.
Dioxin emissions at both incinerators stayed below the 0.1 ng TEQ/m³ target, with Xishan as low as 0.0046 ng TEQ/m³, and a third party verified the levels.
The study was observational and measured accuracy only, so no earlier care for any patient is reported.

After two miscarriages, she had fewer episodes of hypoglycemia and steadier glucose on the device, and the pregnancy reached term without major complications. Whether the device caused the live birth is not shown in the sources.
The trial measured agreement with an expert panel, it did not time the reading and the report gives no result from use after approval.
The evaluations measured accuracy, and WHO reports no screening program's results with the software.
The study measured accuracy against a contact device and did not count room entries or harms avoided.

Two participants gained tablet control, web browsing and typing at home during research sessions. The sources show no lasting daily use by the participants on their own, so the gain is a measurable improvement in what they could do.
The study covers two participants in an early-stage trial, and the sources do not show that the system reached anyone else, so no outcome for society is documented.
The study measured accuracy, and no reduction in contact or infection among staff was measured.
Residents and building managers receive timed alerts, but no individual outcome is documented.
The city proclaimed Lights Out Nights and Houston Audubon issues alerts, but the sources show no measured change in collisions at buildings in Houston.
The evidence on collisions comes from a study in Chicago co-written by BirdCast scientists. A measured change in collisions in Houston itself is absent from the sources.
The FCC measured accuracy and delay on test calls and later found that the service met its minimum standards in operation, but it reports no outcome for users.
Scholars of the Dead Sea Scrolls gained a new finding, published after peer review. The sources show no change at an institution.
People gained knowledge about how one manuscript was made. No wider effect is claimed in the sources.
In the PLATFORM study, 12% of patients with planned angiography in the FFRCT arm had no obstructive disease at angiography, against 73% with functional imaging.
The savings of £391 per patient come from NICE's cost model, and NICE reports no measured spending.
ZEZEDU reports that students improved after one month of use and that internal benchmark scores rose by about 17 percentage points on average. The figures come from the developer's own data.
The developer states that automated grading saves teachers more than 10 hours a week. The figure has no stated method.
The study found that more mothers kept listening to health information. The study did not measure gains in their health.
ARMMAN improved engagement within its limited capacity for staff calls.

The surgeons state that the watch prompted the patient's readmission, where a pulmonary embolism after surgery was investigated and treated. A serious condition was caught in time. The outcome is not detailed, and only an abstract is available.
Visitors could see the composition complete for the first time in 300 years. The benefit is cultural and came from a temporary display.
The museum gained a research-based reconstruction and a public exhibition.

A 65-year-old man with Alzheimer's disease, who had had a stroke the day before, lay unconscious in grass two meters tall after more than 24 hours outdoors. He was found alive and handed to the ambulance service.
GOPR Bieszczady closed a search that police, dogs and ground teams had not resolved, in what it called the first such find in Poland.
Sanyo Electric Railway has not reported a detection that stopped a train or a fall in accidents at the two crossings.
Optage reports comparable function at lower cost than laser radar, and a measured result in cost or safety for Sanyo is missing from the sources.
No person is reported to have been helped.
51.5% of people told their AI result at once attended referral services within 30 days against 39.6% of those told after human grading.
Communities in the program lost an estimated 8.4 ha less tree cover each in the first year, about half the control average, though the confidence interval includes zero.
No individual beneficiary is identified. Patients benefit only indirectly, through preserved hospital budgets.

The result mattered to the hospitals and to the federal budget. The audits cut R$2,381,663.00 from one auction and about R$5.95 million from another. The CGU reports that the five audits avoided R$8.33 million.
The effect is small at national scale, where federal purchasing is about R$119 billion a year.
Assisting the first reviewer with ExaCT cut total extraction time across 75 trials from 21.6 to 17.9 hours in a simulated workflow. No review team is reported to have relied on the tool in live work.
The order approves the approach in one sentence and reports no result from the technology-assisted review.
Physicians identified and treated new heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, and his ejection fraction reached 55% at four months.
No outcome for an organization is reported in this case.
The case concerns a single patient.
The FCC approved the automatic mode on test results before it captioned users' calls, so no outcome for users is reported.
The assessors found timely, good-quality analysis, but they credit SIMONE together with other systems and give no measure.
SHTG reports no figures and judged the evidence for fewer invasive tests to be of limited quality.
No activation attributable to the model's output is documented, so no individual-level outcome can be assigned to the AI.
OCHA adopted the model as its trigger and computes estimates each cycle. The only documented activation (6 November 2025) was triggered by the observational wind-speed threshold.
Pre-landfall assistance in November 2025 (WFP reports 42,100 families) is documented, but in the sources it is not credited to the AI model.
Assisted reads improved sensitivity in 7.3% of biopsy images with cancer, and specificity rose from 88.45% to 89.50%.

The watch called an ambulance for an unconscious victim of a hit-and-run on a quiet road at night, within what Wanbao calls the golden hour. He had abrasions, a neck injury that needed a collar and a suspected bleed at the back of the head. His girlfriend was told where he was. His family call it life-saving, and so does Wanbao in its headline. No clinician or official says so, and a passer-by did reach him, so the sources do not show that it saved his life.
The Control Yuan found in its test that recognition finishes within 3 seconds, a time saving for staff that it did not measure.

The man had ventricular tachycardia at 166 beats per minute, which clinicians ended with electrical cardioversion. On verapamil he had no further complaints over four cardiology visits, so the authors describe a restored rhythm and a condition under control.
Samples were tested blind to imaging, so no patient's referral depended on the result.
In the first year, people hit by trains in suicidal acts at the 14 stations fell from 1.17 to 0.50 a quarter, a population-level fall in serious harm.
The researchers found that canceled train-kilometers in the metro fell after installation, a measured gain for SL's service.
SL logged 36 alarms that led to a person being safeguarded, and the study cannot say which of them would have ended in harm.
The Belvedere adopted the reconstructions and showed them in its 2025 exhibition, according to its exhibition page.
The public can view a hypothesis of the colors of lost works. In a statement that Jing Daily quotes, Smola said that the result was surprising in areas where no knowledge of the colors existed.
The orchestra programmed a premiere that a sponsor funded and that was broadcast live, according to its concert page.

The project produced one new performance and recording of a hypothetical completion. Euronews states that humans chose and arranged the generated themes, and the BR-Klassik critic judged that the music sounds conventional.
The Court found that the checks prevented overpayments but gives no count or amount.
The laboratories obtained a model that covers roughly twice as much of the scaffold of the human nuclear pore complex. That is a material advance for their research.

An atomic model of 70 MDa that covers over 90% of the scaffold is a lasting public resource for research on nuclear transport. The sources show no direct benefit of the scaffold model to patients or the public.

Trial patients with coronary events reached a medical facility in a median of 51 minutes with alarms on and 30.6 hours with alarms off, though fewer deaths or heart attacks were not statistically shown.
Bell reported more than 1.1 billion blocked calls in 15 months, and the CRTC noted that fraud complaints had fallen, but no measure of losses avoided is reported.
No patient outcome is documented.
The proof of concept was tested and reviewed, and its use in live bed management does not appear in the sources.
The code is open source, and no outcome from reuse is documented.

A 190,000-yuan transfer to a suspected romance scammer was canceled after the reminder. By WeChat's account, that averted a serious financial loss for one person. The man is identified only by surname and province, no police or bank confirmation is reported, and the case date is not given.

The authors report that both patients gained enough prosthetic control for activities of daily living, with the most recent follow-ups at 18 months and 2 years. The authors give no validated functional scores in the abstract, so a lasting change is not established.
The report covers two patients at one hospital, and no source reports a realized outcome beyond them, so no societal depth can be established.
The people concerned are owners of pools who pay more tax. The sources show no benefit to a person from the scheme.
The communes concerned received about 10 million euros of extra land-tax revenue for 2022, a measurable gain that the Cour des comptes and the Sénat report restate.
The tax administration and the Cour des comptes report no effect on tax fairness or compliance across society. The Cour des comptes judges that the scheme mainly demonstrates the capacity to detect.
The authors report the yield of screening for the group. They do not document an individual's outcome or the results of treatment.

The organization that ran the screening reports a number needed to screen of 44.9 for portable X-rays with CAD in six states in 2022. For its other main strategies of case finding, the number ranged from 49.0 to 388.5. That is a measured gain in case finding.

The organization reports that the program diagnosed 2,337 people with TB in hard-to-reach communities (2,481 in its tables) and that 97.3% started treatment, a measurable result in case finding. It reports no cure rates or effects on transmission.

The researchers measured mean herbicide savings of 28.4% to 62.4% across the three application timings, with weed control comparable to broadcast spraying and no yield increase. These savings lower the grower's input costs.
Less herbicide was sprayed in the trials, but they did not measure an environmental outcome off the plots.

AIZEN reports that partner lenders financed more than 20,000 electric two-wheelers, which gave borrowers access to a vehicle and to credit. Neither AIZEN nor the partner lenders have published evidence of higher income or lasting financial security for borrowers.

AIZEN reports that CreditConnect-EV lets partner lenders approve loans for electric two-wheelers at scale, which traditional scorecards made infeasible. The profitability of these loans and any fall in defaults are unreported.
AIZEN intends to lower pollution from transport. The sources include no measure of the emissions that the financed vehicles avoided.

The institute states that capacity 'can reach' 60–80% more with a single-layer layout and about 50% more for a lot of about 100 spaces. Both are conditional estimates, and no garage reports a realized gain.
The institute describes easier parking and vehicle retrieval in garages that already use the system. The claim is qualitative, and no source measures a change in waiting time.
The auditors found that risk events fell but gave no count of the events or of any harm avoided.
PNNL estimated that load shedding on the predicted days cut the building's capacity and transmission charges by $20,000 for 2022, a cost saving.
The audit office found that the payment rate rose from around 50% to 90% in 2022, the city's target, after the scan cars came into use.
The first round approved 60,471 accountability reports, about 20% of the FNDE's backlog, though 66% of the school-meal reports still awaited analysis.
The tool pointed supervisors to two MSBs where on-site examinations found weaknesses in ongoing due diligence.
The reports measure the AI's accuracy on images and users' opinions, and neither reports an outcome for a grower's crop.

The authors report timely curative surgery for a lung adenocarcinoma with clear margins and no nodal spread, a serious condition resolved in time, and judge that without the watch it would have grown undetected.

An unknown number of Android users near Alanya had a few seconds' notice of a quake. AFAD and the district governor said that it caused no damage or injuries. Neither Google nor the Turkish press says that a recipient took protective action. Hürriyet reported on 7 January 2022 that most users who posted about the alert said that they panicked.

The alert led physicians to recognize symptomatic bradycardia caused by a drug and to change her antibiotic, after which her heart rate returned to normal. The authors say that a potential adverse event was prevented, and they document no imminent event.
A correct molecular diagnosis replaced a misdiagnosis held since age four. The Akita neurologists report no change in treatment.

Baidu reports round-the-clock sign language coverage and over 100 million views. A Deaf professor's team found that the Olympic avatars lost or distorted important information and that Deaf viewers had difficulty understanding the signing. So the extent of any gain in access for Deaf viewers cannot be established.
Broadcasters gained continuous AI sign language output for a major event. The gain is in service capability, and no comparison of costs is given.
Event rates fell after alerts went live at five of six agencies analyzed, a measured change in how operators drove.
The evaluators measured warning events, and the report gives no crash figures, so no gain in road safety is shown.
The approved version was tested on stored trial data, and no diagnosis depended on its results.
Trial patients felt less pain with the earlier device's throat photo than with the swab, but no patient has yet been diagnosed with the approved version.

The Swiss Plasma Center gained a controller that the authors call a notable advance for tokamak feedback control. The controller reduced the design effort for new configurations and made new droplet experiments possible.
No societal outcome beyond research progress is documented.
Patients examined with the algorithm received a correct diagnosis in 53.9% of cases against 43.8% without it.
Non-dermatology trainees diagnosed 54.7% of lesions correctly with the algorithm against 30.7% without it.
The woman survived a life-threatening hemorrhage and regained an active life. Mayo credits AI with speeding her diagnosis.
Patients with large vessel occlusion reached thrombectomy 11.2 minutes sooner after activation, and their functional outcomes did not differ.
Stroke teams cut door-to-groin and CT-to-treatment intervals across four centers.

A 57-year-old woman learned early that she had large vessel vasculitis, which the authors call a potentially severe disease, after a chest CT had been read as normal. Treatment brought her resting heart rate back to normal within ten days and her inflammatory markers within two weeks. Four weeks after treatment began, she reported that she was well. A serious condition was resolved in time.
The counts of flagged messages and blocked numbers are totals for all users, and the police have documented no loss that an identifiable user avoided.
The government has not credited a measured change in scam losses to the app.
Recipients received cash, but the Malawi researchers report no gain for recipients that the targeting by phone data itself produced.

Drawing on GiveDirectly's 2023 synthesis, the World Bank authors report that the hybrid approach cost about half as much per added enrollee as in-person surveys alone. That is a cost saving for the program.
No population-level outcome is documented, and the World Bank authors found little targeting gain over random choice at the 80% cutoff.
Accuracy was measured on stored scans in the maker's pre-market trial, the screening time was not measured and the report gives no result from use after approval.

The authors measured its accuracy, and its predicted date agrees with an independent re-dating of Athenian decrees. No verified result from Ithaca in the work of scholars is documented in the sources.

The hospital reports a successful implantation, with the stimulator working normally and the electrodes precisely placed. The trial team reports seizure reductions for the cohort and gives no seizure outcome for this patient.

The stop removed 112 grams of crack cocaine and a semiautomatic pistol from a driver who, per a prosecutor filing that Forbes cites, had made nine trafficking-pattern trips. He pleaded guilty, received 48 months and agreed to a $34,000 forfeiture, per the court docket. The sentence was later commuted, and the sources show no measured effect on drug supply or violence.
The laboratory solved a structure that two years of standard methods had failed to solve.

Police seized 52.5 kg of explosive, assessed as PETN-RDX, before anyone could use it. The minister said that the target was Istanbul. The court convicted five men of supplying weapons to a terrorist organization. The harm averted could have been an attack with many casualties, though reporters did not establish the plan.
The Hakkari police got a lead that ended in a seizure, five arrests and five convictions. The minister counted it among 15 similar actions that police had stopped that year.
Patients at risk of neutropenia gained a home test whose counts correlated with trained operators' counts at 0.97 for white cells and 0.95 for neutrophil percentage.
Children in the score group had 21 percent fewer injury admissions and were 60 percent less likely to fall in the top one percent of the harm index.
Screening teams shifted investigations toward children more likely to be harmed without changing the rate of investigation.
The evaluators credit the chatbot and WhatsApp with enhanced remote and real-time monitoring, transparency and communication across 336 field visits, without separating the chatbot's share.
Project participants could submit complaints and get answers to queries through the chatbot and WhatsApp, a convenience whose uptake the review does not count.
Callers and recipients are meant to exchange richer information, and no use has been reported.
Telecom providers and content producers are meant to deliver new services, and no operational benefit has been reported.
The vendor describes customers whose social-engineering transfers of EUR 125,000 and USD 170,000 were blocked, a loss averted for each. No customer is named or independently documented.

The vendor states that a USD 500,000 (KSh 58 million) ATM fraud was stopped with arrests. It says that payments up to USD 850,000 were blocked before funds left client banks. The losses averted are serious if the account holds. Customers, banks and dates are not given.
The vendor gives no aggregate figure that a regulator has verified.
The FCC measured accuracy and delay on test calls and later found that the service met its minimum standards, but it reports no outcome for users.
Independent groups at Texas A&M University and the University of Waterloo reused the enzyme in their own laboratory systems. The sources report bench work and no production deployment.

Near-complete degradation of post-consumer PET was shown only in the laboratory, and under larger-scale conditions FAST-PETase converted 18.1 percent of post-consumer PET in 24 hours. No group in the sources reports that any plastic waste was recycled outside a laboratory.
The ANAO reports that the share of SG compliance cases raising a liability rose from about 60–70 percent to 90 percent with the new models.
Employees gain when unpaid super is raised as a liability, but the report gives no amounts recovered through these models.
The randomized trial measured lower all-cause mortality within 90 days.

The National Audit Office reports the department's finding that the model is about three times better at identifying fraud risk than a random control sample. That is a measured gain in capability. The saving of £4.4 million over three years is small. Civil Service World reports that it rests on about 7,000 rejected requests out of more than a million advances a year.

The department has reported no outcome for claimants or the public beyond its estimated saving. Referred claimants face added evidence demands. The department's fairness analyses showed that older claimants and claimants who are not UK nationals were over-referred.
No identified individual beneficiary. Villagers near three units are mentioned only as sources of daily notifications.

Researchers and forest department officials received tiger alerts 30 to 42 seconds after detection during the two-month pilot. Officials then sent text-chat warnings to village leaders, although the authors say that these messages were not rapid.
No effect on human-wildlife conflict was measured in the two-month pilot of 12 cameras.
VA researchers report 22% lower odds of death within four months for patients under the review mandate across all 140 medical centers, as an exploratory outcome.
Patients under the mandate were five times more likely to receive a case review and received on average 0.5 more risk mitigation strategies.
Speakers can translate text to and from their languages in a free tool, a convenience, and the sources report no measured use or outcome.
An activist and a scholar expect the service to support the languages' survival, and no source measures an effect on any language.

A 29-year-old had his occluded artery reopened within 60 minutes of arrival and reports being alive with no deficits. The AI's share is the time saved in fast-tracking the cath lab team after EMS had already pre-notified the hospital and the team was ready. The thrombectomy was the treatment.
Dr Mehta states that the platform simplifies the work and saves time compared with the old need to open scans at workstations.
Psychologists from the prosecutors' office visited the 17-year-old and recommended urgent psychological support. Whether he received it, or anything else came of the visit, is not known.
Officials checked the public post within a day and found no weapon or plan. Police said that many such alerts turn out to be jokes, so the sources do not show that harm was prevented.
The authors report extensive testing with visually impaired school children, and the need that prompted the work: only three books in Irish Braille. They identify no pupil, date or measured gain.
Access to written Irish for the 4,701 school-age blind or visually impaired people cited from the 2016 census is the stated aim. No figure for uptake is given.
The effects are averages across treated households, and the sources show no single household whose outcome changed because of an alert.

Across treated village councils under severe flooding, households were 12.7 percentage points less likely to have their home flooded and borrowed less after floods. In their four-season analysis, the authors find no effect on physical health.
The hospital that treated her described timely treatment of a severe infection, followed by her recovery and discharge. It has not shown that she would otherwise have died.
Nineteen women had breast cancer found at screening only because the AI flagged their examinations (269 cancers with AI against 250 without).
Patt reports that Lee confirmed a photograph of his mother at Bergen-Belsen and then found photographs of her extended family. Fixler found images of herself, her aunt and her cousin (NPR, BBC).

The BBC reports that Fixler's recognition doubled the number of identified people in one US Holocaust Memorial Museum photo, from three to six. No formal update of the archive for the Lee photograph is recorded in the sources.
Two documented identifications among the millions of unidentified faces that the tool indexes are a small benefit to society.
No realized output of the algorithm is documented.
No recovered revenue attributable to VeRa is documented.
Targeted therapy for leptomeningeal disease started a week earlier and whole-neuraxis radiotherapy was avoided, with MRI improvement at two months. No source reports a survival benefit.
The slide-based prediction let the team choose a single rapid PCR test on limited tissue without waiting for sequencing.
Lay users with no training tested their own urine, and 92.7% of their ACR results matched a trained operator's.
The lower miss rate was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, in which every patient also had the other exam, and the report gives no result from use after approval.

Pat Bennett communicated from a large vocabulary at the pace of conversation in research sessions. The team called the work a proof of concept. The authors of a study in 2025 report that she still communicated mainly with a writing board or an iPad.
The savings are modeled because COVID-19 rules kept the optimized schedules from running, and the subscription cost more than the modeled utility savings.
Women had measurable improvements in knowledge and reported care practices.
More high-risk patients attended their visits. The no-show rate fell from 36% to 33%, and from 42% to 36% for Black patients.
Schedulers focused limited call time on appointments that the model ranked as high risk.
Detection was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that the prompts guided any patient's care.
Pedestrians stand to gain, but IIHS reports track tests with dummies and no crash outcomes.

Ann Johnson communicated through decoded text, a synthetic voice and an avatar in research sessions at her home. The researchers report no use on her own outside those sessions. Her implant was removed in February 2024.

Yamagata University's Institute of Nasca reports a sixteen-fold increase in the discovery rate. The German Aerospace Center says that the survey achieved in six months what had previously taken decades.
The known corpus of figurative geoglyphs at a UNESCO World Heritage site nearly doubled, with 303 confirmed sites added to Peru's archaeological record.

Forest officials received the images in near real time and identified the individuals. The authors document an investigation and no arrest or prosecution, so the gain recorded is a lead for investigators.

Protection of the reserve's wildlife from this gang is claimed through arrests only in the Clemson release, developer material and The Hindu's second-hand report. The authors note a chital presumably poached before the second detection.
In its submission, iSciLab lists a Korean horse-passport pilot and African tests for rabies tracking, with no measured improvement in management.
Animal welfare, rabies prevention and reduced illegal trade are proposed effects. Neither the company nor the Korean government reports an observed outcome for any of them.

The watch's 88% reading, against 97% on hospital oximetry, led to the diagnosis and anticoagulant treatment of a pulmonary embolism with bilateral deep venous thrombosis, after which her symptoms improved and she went home on day 15.
No German fatality data are documented.
No operator or site outcome is documented.
