One patient had a diffuse glioma found during her scan. She had a biopsy the next day and was referred for immediate treatment of the cancer. The authors report no follow-up and no change in her outcome. The words “saved a life” come from the headline of Anadolu Agency, and the authors make no such claim.

Crisis messages from patients were triaged by a crisis specialist within minutes on median. The authors report no clinical outcome for any patient and list hospitalization and emergency department use as future work.

In their study, the company's authors report that the daily median time from message to triage by a crisis specialist fell to 8 to 13 minutes. Before deployment it averaged over 9 hours. The baseline comes from Cerebral's internal analysis, and the sources show no independent measure of either figure.

NRW police resolved an amok-threat email address to a person in fractions of a second. They identified 51 of about 100 shooting participants at about 20 minutes each, per the ministry and a Duisburg investigator. No comparison with conventional methods and no charges or convictions are reported.

Siegen's administration and public had the author of a threatened amok attack identified. Neither the police nor the ministry says whether the threat was credible, whether the person was charged or what harm was averted.
Cao and colleagues report that PANDA found five cancers that the initial standard of care had missed. One patient then had surgery with curative intent for a 1.5 cm pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor.
PANDA exceeded mean radiologist sensitivity by 34.1% and specificity by 6.3% for pancreatic cancer identification in the evaluated cohorts.
Lives saved and benefits from population screening are possible later effects. The authors of an independent 2026 review report that no study shows an effect on stage at diagnosis or survival.
More veterans had precancerous adenomas found and removed. Detection rose from 50.7% to 54.9% of colonoscopies at equipped facilities.
The VA raised adenoma detection, a core measure of colonoscopy quality, by 4.2 percentage points without a change in withdrawal time.

Researchers in algebraic complexity gained new explicit decompositions, and Kauers and Moosbauer improved the 5x5 one within a week. The gains hold only over particular fields. In Nature, the authors report the 4x4 improvement for matrices “in a finite field”. Kauers and Moosbauer give the 5x5 record of 96 multiplications over the field with two elements.
Most anesthesiologists in the study judged that the device helped them find the correct view, and no measured gain in block results is reported.
Agreement was measured against a reading panel in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that the prompts guided care.
Huntsman's review met the special master's benchmark for a reasonable search, so Huntsman did not have to resume it.

INEC's chairman reported that 2,780,756 ineligible entries (22.6% of new registrations) were removed from the register used for the 2023 general election. BusinessDay disputed completeness and regional balance, and the European Union observers reported that underage registrants remained in unknown numbers.
INEC obtained a cleaned register and identified 23 of its own officers for sanctions over multiple registrations.

The Philippine Red Cross reports that 78 households had their roofs and walls reinforced before landfall and that the kits mitigated the wind's impact. The claim rests on its own post-storm survey, which has no comparison group.
This was the first completed activation of the Philippine typhoon protocol. In the final report, the Red Cross records lessons about lead time and the limits that the weather set.
The 390 people reached are the members of the reinforced households. The Philippine Red Cross reports no outcome beyond them.
The tests used stored recordings, so no patient in cardiac arrest was treated.
The authors measured how accurately the recognizer identified recorded test words. They document no use of the system in her real conversations.
The study tested one person on a vocabulary of 13 words, so no effect on a population is documented.
Staff read smears in the maker's pre-market trial against an expert panel, and the report does not say that the readings guided any patient's care.

A 17-year-old had posted videos with poison and an apparent cut. She was reached and counseled within about an hour of the alert and sent home with a small cut on her wrist. By her own account she wanted to scare her boyfriend. An averted suicide rests on the police's framing and is not established.
No detection, stop or avoided accident is documented.
Only stable operation in trials and later expansion are reported.
No rescue credited to the system appears in the sources.
No individual beneficiary is identified. Beneficiaries are public bodies and bidders in corrected tenders.
The result is material to the audited municipal and state bodies: 53 of 60 alerts answered and notices worth R$91,723,011.31 corrected, by the court's own aggregate figures.
This covers one month of tenders in one state. The court gives no estimate of money saved, only the value of notices corrected.

In the detection rates that FHI took from a FIGO guide for its model, the algorithm detected 74.8% of preterm preeclampsia against 44.8% for maternal factors, at a screen-positive rate of 10%. The rates come from screening studies in other countries. Norway had not introduced the screening.
The 173 preterm cases avoided each year are FHI's projection for Norway, which had not introduced the screening.
Survivors of violence got information, referrals and counseling through the chatbots, with 90% of users satisfied by figures that the evaluators relay from the completion report.
The evaluators found that the chatbot services enabled broader reach to vulnerable, at-risk populations beyond hotlines that could not serve several callers at once.
The trial measured a large increase in completed diabetic eye exams. The trial's authors do not show that the extra exams improved vision or prevented blindness.
The authors report lower mortality after deployment. The comparison comes from a model built on historical data, with no randomization.
Women in the AI group had 338 cancers found at screening against 262 in the control group, and the extra invasive cancers were mainly small and node-negative.
The screening service needed 61,248 screen readings in the AI group against 109,692 in the control group, a 44.2% reduction.
EMA and AQuAS assessed predictions on past cohorts and trials, and neither reports a trial result or a patient's care that depended on iBox.
Newly implanted patients had better speech intelligibility at 3 and 12 months. Experienced users had median gains of 10% in speech scores.
The authors report that the FOX approach was equivalent or superior in “hearing performance, comfort, and resources”.
The Brussels studies each come from a single center, and the sources show no outcome across a population.

A man with a 99 percent stenosis of the left anterior descending artery had it stented after the software flagged a 72 percent probability of severe narrowing. The manual reading of his exercise electrocardiogram had rated his risk moderate and would have left him to drug treatment and follow-up. The cardiologist put his chance of an acute infarction at 8 in 10. He said that the stent removed the risk of sudden death. The man left hospital, and his symptoms improved markedly. The hospital calls the case life-saving in its headlines. But the harm lay in the future, and the only account comes from the hospital that built the model, so no source shows that a life was saved.
Students achieved a measurable improvement in immediate post-test scores. The trial did not establish a lasting change in their capabilities.
The course demonstrated a teaching format with better post-test results. This rating rests on the same trial as the student rating, and no separate organizational study is cited.

A boy who had chronic pain for three years received a diagnosis and corrective spinal surgery. He had also come to drag his left foot and had stopped growing taller. In November 2024 his mother said that he is a new kid now. No source shows that the surgery saved his life.
Owners of detected pools bear a cost, and no individual beneficiary is documented.

The DGFiP estimates that the tool added about €40 million in local property tax for 2023. The Cour des comptes reports €4.4 million in recurring revenue and €5.7 million in back-tax from the 2022 pilot. In Dordogne alone the public-finance office is recovering tax on about 1,500 pools.
About €40 million nationally is small against total property-tax receipts. The DGFiP gives two counts of pools in its own report, 140,000 and more than 120,000.

No individual beneficiary of the controls is identified. The people directly affected are those investigated. By Amnesty's reading of UDK's figures, 54% to almost 90% of opened cases per model ended with no further action.

By UDK's own 2023 figures, three models produced 135, 36 and 72 cases with revenue from 412, 511 and 491 requested cases. No amounts are given, and UDK says that yearly figures are not directly comparable.

No societal outcome is reported beyond the cases with revenue that UDK counts for itself. The 2023 figures come without amounts, so the extent of any gain to public funds cannot be established, and Amnesty questions whether the models are effective.

The developer reports that municipal pilots inspected more than 30 km of water mains. The project gathered 109,350 labeled records, which passed a quality check within the government data project. Neither the developer nor the partner towns have shown that pipeline failures were avoided.
More reliable water service and fewer leaks are intended, and the developer reports no measured effect on public resources or safety.
vivo reports offline speech, vision and sign language assistance that expands communication and access to information. It gives user numbers but reports no measure of whether the gains last.
vivo asserts a 90% reduction in cloud energy use. It gives no measure of the total energy use of devices and cloud or the net environmental effect.
Students assigned to the chatbot were four percentage points more likely to earn an A or B in the course.
Accountants checked 31.9% fewer requests and found errors in 8.53% of AI-analyzed requests, against 1.65% in the year before TAAP.
The evaluator found that cancelling over 21,500 km² of farmland from the hazard database in 2023 let farming resume quickly.
The evaluator found that AI-enabled approaches supported land cancellation and prioritization for the national authorities in charge of mine action.
Dropout among students in the treatment schools fell by 0.92 percentage points, about half of the 1.58 percent average.
The evaluator found that the monitoring's scope widened but gives no count of radio items captured or acted on.
The disinformation found during the elections is not attributed to the application.
The iVerify team processed 265 fact-checking requests during a tense election, though no effect on public discourse is measured.
The evaluator reports that findings reached the commission but gives no count of posts flagged or of actions that the commission took.
No change in misinformation or hate speech around the 2023 local elections is measured, and the public did not receive the data.
The study puts the cost of reading an X-ray at INR 30 with qXR and INR 22 with Genki, against INR 100 for a radiologist.
Providers' allowable expenses for automatic captions averaged about $0.60 per minute in 2023, against $1.04 per minute with assistants.
The TRS Fund paid $1.30 per minute for both modes until this order, so its savings depend on the automatic rate that falls from $1.17 to $0.95 per minute.
Doctors read cases in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that the marks guided any patient's care.

An infant received a definitive molecular diagnosis of a disorder that the authors say frequently causes early death before age two. A multidisciplinary meeting the same day coordinated gastrostomy tube placement and long-term goals. In their series of 2026, the treating team report that the result informed family planning and started disease-specific supportive care. It also changed her level of care and helped her move to palliative care because of the poor prognosis.

In this single case, preliminary results were returned on 10 January 2023, five days after the sample was shipped on 5 January 2023. Genomic panels and a microarray sent from the institution were still pending and were anticipated to take longer than one month. The authors do not say what became of those tests.
The website offers accessibility functions, and no measured change in use, understanding or health has been reported for its users.
The agency asserts that the chatbot reduces staff workload and gives no comparison of workload before and after the launch.
Universal access and lower emissions are intended effects, and the agency reports no measure of either.
The developers and the responders credit no individual rescue or beneficiary to the maps.

The developer and a World Bank specialist report that responders received building-level damage maps within hours or minutes, where such an assessment would typically take weeks. The developer reports that teams found damaged areas that they had been unaware of. No responding agency gives its own account.
No downstream effect on rescues, shelter siting or reconstruction is documented. The maps covered part of the affected zone after imagery became usable on 9 February 2023.
The authors count 204 cancers diagnosed after safety-net reassessment, a measurable gain, but say that it is unclear whether the extra detection lowers interval cancers or improves stage.
Detection was 6.7 per 1,000 with AI against 5.7 per 1,000 without, and the recall rate did not rise.
No outcome is attributable to the AI. Contributors using the AI-assisted editor mapped more slowly, and the editor was later disabled, according to the OSM wiki.
No outcome is attributable to the AI. Responders' use of OSM data is documented, but no link to AI-derived features appears in the sources. The AI-assisted editor slowed mapping.
No outcome attributable to the AI is documented.
The trial measured a 22% cut in the share of trip time ridden on sidewalks across 456 trips, a measurable change in rider behavior. No crash or injury outcome was measured.
No outcome for Spin or the city is documented beyond compliance behavior.
No outcome for an individual rider is documented.
Patients whose fentanyl was dosed by the index had median pain scores in recovery 1.6 points lower in one trial and 1.5 points lower in the other.

The court gained lawyer-verified transcripts of Constitution Bench hearings on a trial basis. It had published them for 9 of 25 hearings by May 2023 and for almost ten main matters by December 2023. By February 2024 it published them regularly within days of a hearing.

Transcripts were published on the court's website for public and academic use, for only a minority of hearings in the first months. By February 2024 they appeared regularly within days of a hearing, and a judge reproduced part of one in the Electoral Bonds judgment.
The estimates were checked on stored studies, and no clinician used them to guide care.
Where fingerprint scanning failed, observers saw facial recognition accredit voters so that they could vote, and the EU mission saw fewer rejections. No mission counted the voters affected.
The EU and Commonwealth observers saw INEC's polling staff accredit voters faster with the facial mode than with fingerprints.

A 6 mm cancer was treated at an early stage with surgery and a short radiotherapy course. Dr Lip states that cancers picked up under 15 mm carry around 95% survival. No follow-up in the sources shows that it saved this patient's life.
Across the 10,889-woman evaluation Mia helped find 12% more cancers. In a statement, the University of Aberdeen said that this would not put more women through additional tests.
Pathologists read slides faster in the maker's pre-market trial, where microscope reading was the reference, so no time saved in routine work is measured.

A 25-year-old man received a diagnosis of atrial fibrillation confirmed by electrocardiogram. He then had cardioversion to sinus rhythm and four weeks of anticoagulation. The authors do not describe the outcome as life-saving.
By the owner's own account, the diagnosis led to treatment and to his dog's near-full recovery. No veterinarian has verified the account. The beneficiaries are one owner and one dog.
One person avoided a £60 fine that she considered wrongly issued. She also saved the time of drafting an appeal, which she said that she found hard to articulate.
The comparison ran on recorded data, and FDA credits no rescue to the device's alarms.
In the regulator's test sends, the free filters blocked 97.7% of illegal spam texts in the second half of 2022, up from 89.5% in the second half of 2019.
Five adults without respiratory symptoms had early-stage lung cancer diagnosed, four with curative surgery. The authors report positive outcomes but no survival data.
No individual outcome is documented.
The IRS gives no results from the AI-selected examinations, and GAO reports only officials' claims about a pilot.
No revenue or fairness outcome is attributed to the models.
Endoscopists found more polyps with the software in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report gives no outcome of care.
Patients in the software group had more of their polyps detected, but the report gives no outcome for their health.

In the Cornwall evaluation 13 of 14 carers reported peace of mind, and clinicians changed the seizure management strategy for all but one participant. No outcome such as seizure control or injury is measured.
Nelli recorded 707 possible seizure events in 14 people, 247 of them unheard or unrecognized by carers, and the authors report improved communication and care planning.
The sources name no one who benefited.
No deployment has been reported.
No event can be credited to the models.
Participants given ChatGPT hints showed a 17.00 percent learning gain from pre-test to post-test, statistically significant against a no-hint control.

The prosecutor's office reported that a gang responsible for at least eight accredited violent robberies was detained and brought before the Noveno Juzgado de Garantía. Four adults went to preventive detention.
Prosecutors state that the tool replaces review of hundreds of case files with a short list of proposed links.
No avoided blackout or deployment is documented.
No grid operator use is documented.
The gain was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report gives no outcome of care and does not say how each group used the software.
The council reports that proactive support prevented homelessness in a high-risk cohort. The groups were not randomized, and AI’s separate effect is unknown.

The government reports that the approach increased prevention effectiveness by 65% and avoided 96 homelessness cases from June 2023 to January 2025. Neither the government nor the councils give sample sizes or an independent evaluation.
Weighted kappa against the expert panel rose from 0.297 to 0.419 for lobular inflammation and from 0.414 to 0.563 for ballooning in 1,481 cases.
Officers reached alert locations 1 minute 38 seconds sooner on average than outdoor shots reported to 911 in June 2023.
The audit does not link faster arrival to victims helped or shootings solved, and most alerts were not confirmed as shootings.

Dubai Culture and Khalifa University report that the completed pilot detected known excavation areas, predicted new zones and produced a geospatial knowledge base. No new find has been confirmed by excavation.
Heritage conservation is an intended benefit, and Dubai Culture has published no measure of avoided damage or wider effects on preservation.
The risk levels were assigned to stored samples, and no clinician acted on them.
The group found that double reading with AI support may detect one more breast cancer for every 1,000 women screened, an estimate that rests on a simulation with archived examinations.
The Commissioner found that the AI identifies offending accurately, and by September 2025 Victoria Police had issued 188,493 infringements from 31,437,979 vehicles photographed.
The Auditor-General found that the department does not know whether the program reduces crashes, injuries or deaths.
Review with the software was more sensitive in nearly all screening studies and faster in all nine reading-time studies, though less specific.
Doctors scored past scans in the maker's pre-market trial, so no patient's care depended on the scores.
In one DIII-D session the controlled plasmas tracked a stable path with fewer disruptions and higher time-integrated beta. The authors describe this as a path toward scenarios relevant to ITER.
No outcome beyond fusion research is documented.
Participants with ChatGPT finished writing tasks in 40% less time, with quality 18% higher.
The Rubin Observatory and the DiRAC team at the University of Washington tested the linking software successfully on real data before the ten-year survey began.
One potentially hazardous asteroid about 600 feet across was added to the catalog. The astronomers state that it poses no foreseeable risk to Earth, so the benefit is knowledge of the object.
CSE reports that some farmers in Sehore, Vidisha and Bhopal valued faster payment of claims than before. That is time saved. Other farmers in the same districts report lower claims than their losses.

District officials told CSE that claims for similar crop losses had become more consistent since the technology came in. They gave no figures and also called the process opaque. The PIB states that settlement is faster and gives no figures.
The PIB reports adoption by nine states, and CSE later reports twelve. No outcome at scale is documented. Down To Earth reports that payouts in three districts fell sharply between 2018 and 2024.
The sources do not name a beneficiary.
Bradford Museums exhibited the painting as a possible Raphael and extended the display “due to popular demand”.
The attribution is not accepted by scholars or institutions.
The screen predicted a specific candidate, Tmem81, that the laboratory then validated genetically and biochemically. This was a measurable research result for that group.

The laboratory identified a fertilization factor that vertebrates share and that male zebrafish and mice need to be fertile. It helps answer a long-standing open question. The laboratory has not reported a clinical application.

In the laboratory, the participant controlled grasping, including feeding himself, as AI decoded his intended movements, alongside spinal stimulation and sensory feedback. One person regained meaningful abilities. The authors do not isolate the contribution of each component.

Casey Harrell can talk with his family and colleagues again. In its follow-up of 2026, the team reported that he used the system for more than 3,800 hours at home with no researchers present. He communicated nearly two million words and kept working full time.
Treated students' growth in math scores exceeded that of controls by 0.36 standard deviations on the same 35-question test. The gain is reported in the second version of the preprint.
The authors estimate a marginal cost of about $5 per student. Rising Academies and the authors report no saving and no changed result for the school network.

Across millions of driverless miles, Waymo drew fewer bodily-injury claims and had fewer injury crashes than the human benchmark. It had zero bodily-injury claims against 1.11 per million miles, and 81% fewer injury crashes in the study by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety. How serious the avoided injuries would have been is unknown.
Waymo faced fewer property-damage liability claims per mile than the human baseline (0.78 against 3.26 per million miles), a measured reduction in claims against the operator.
No individual who benefited is documented, and the comparisons are rates across all miles.
Independent classroom studies in Indonesia report that students who used QANDA reached significantly higher mathematics results. This is a measurable improvement in a result for those students.
Students with GPT-4 finished each legal task faster, saving 11.8% to 32.1% of their time.
The sensitivity and specificity come from historical records, and no patient was referred for follow-up because of the software.
ICE reports several confirmed rescues of children from active abuse and 14 positive contacts. The number of rescues is unstated.
ICE and NBC News report that more than 100 leads went to field offices and partner countries. They report that active abusers were arrested in the United States and Canada.

Cal Fire's Mount Laguna station received a verified alert at about 3 a.m. Its crews put the fire out at under a quarter acre. Suzann Leininger, an intelligence specialist at Cal Fire, said: “It's getting us time to react in a faster manner”.

The area around Mount Laguna was spared a larger fire. Captain Yeary judged that it “could have been a devastating fire”. Battalion Chief Slumpff judged that it would probably have reached hundreds of acres. Neither judgment rests on a measurement of what would have happened without the alert.
No individual beneficiary or per-party outcome is documented. The STF says that its figures do not refer to decisions taken with AI help and do not allow calculating time saved.

The tool mattered to the court's screening work. In one controversy VitorIA identified at least 247 appeals with similar legal questions. The STF describes this as the technology taking part in organizing and identifying patterns in its case flow. The STF does not quantify time saved.
No source reports an outcome for society. The STF says that finding the similar appeals did not determine the result, and no cited source says what happened to the 247 appeals.

The surgeons said that without urgent surgery he faced hemiplegia, loss of speech, blurred vision or death. After the guided operation, done while he was awake, computed tomography showed no clot left. His movement, vision and cognition were normal, and he went home on day six. If a life was saved, the credit belongs to the operation as a whole. The robot's part lay in preserving function.

The fire was held to 52 acres, and the evacuation was lifted the same afternoon, according to Cal Fire and KBAK. A risk was removed for the neighborhood. The claim that the camera network detected it first comes only from ALERTCalifornia's founder via Microsoft.

Microsoft's feature says that the cameras and AI helped crews detect the fire quickly. Neither Microsoft nor the Kern County Fire Department says which agency received an alert or when it arrived relative to 911 calls. The extent of any gain to an organization therefore cannot be established.

Dubai Municipality reports that cement tests that took four days now take eight minutes, and that daily samples rose by 650 percent. These figures measure time saved and throughput, and no change in test quality or construction outcomes has been reported.
Lower exposure of staff to hazardous materials is intended. No measured exposure or health result has been reported.
No individual outcome is documented.
This is a general benefit. The sources show no forecast office that used the GraphCast run for Lee in its products.
This is a general benefit. No public-safety decision has been linked to the run.

U.S. Customs and Border Protection made a seizure and two arrests from a flag that, Mayorkas said, took 1.4 seconds. The Department of Homeland Security opens both its page on artificial intelligence and its roadmap of 2024 with the case, as its example of artificial intelligence in use.
The seized load did not reach U.S. streets, but the drug has not been named, and the border agency has not shown which harm the seizure averted.
The accuracy was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that the software's results guided any patient's care.
Traficom found from program samples that the subtitles became clear enough to meet the legal requirement, with names, numbers and foreign words spelled correctly and sentences punctuated.
The study measured agreement with manual microscopy, and no gain in time or accuracy at any laboratory is reported.
Consultants below the average baseline score raised their task performance by 43%, and those above it by 17%.
The tasks were designed for the experiment, and no outcome for Boston Consulting Group as a firm has been reported.

Participants who are identified by number report that they identified airport gate numbers, recognized their surroundings, located a dropped hair tie and read a check on their own. The results are small and self-reported, and the authors of the same papers document frequent errors.
The participant communicated in text at a median 10.2 characters per minute in laboratory sessions that totaled 626 minutes over 90 days. No home use is reported.
No outcome for the hospital or any other organization is reported.
The study has a single participant.
Researchers reported time savings of 3 to 80 minutes, and experts estimated 10 to 30 minutes, with contours of similar quality.

The seafarer received a diagnosis, rate control and aspirin at sea, a diversion to port and confirmation in the hospital. He was repatriated without complications. The authors say that the service “has the potential to save lives”. No life-threatening complication is documented.
The CIRM duty doctor could base a rhythm diagnosis and a diversion decision on an electrocardiogram trace as well as the symptoms. No measure beyond the single decision is given.
The council reports less time spent on call wrap-up and executive-assistant tasks.
A deaf colleague can follow speakers, review discussions and check emails more independently. The duration of that improvement is unknown.
The councils report that the tagging and summary tools cut repetitive administrative time and that they made the tools available to all departments.
Planning officers spend less time processing consultation responses by hand. The earlier rise in public participation came from digital engagement before these AI tools.
Learners in treatment schools scored 0.534 standard deviations higher on the IDELA assessment of early learning.
Farm staff scored gill disease weekly by conventional means. The authors report no farm decision that the activity signal changed.
No outcome for farm staff or for fish welfare is documented beyond the link between behavior and gill disease.
Xinhua states that the program “has helped the farm increase the survival rate of lion-head geese by 30 percent”. No baseline, period or verification is given.
Farmer Jin Shutao is named, but no personal outcome beyond the farm figure is reported.
CR measured the system in its own tests and reports no crash outcome for drivers or passengers.
CR measured the system in its own tests and reports no crash outcome for drivers or passengers.
The bureau approved the shuttle for service with no driver on the campus, and no outcome from that service is reported.
The bureau approved the shuttle for service with no driver on a conformity check, and no outcome for riders or other road users is reported.
No benefit to a specific person from the cyclone forecasts appears in the sources. The study measures the errors of forecasts.
The CIRA study measured an 11% lower 120 h track error in a test consensus that NHC did not use in 2023, so no organization is reported to have gained from it.
NHC did not use the AI models in 2023 operations, so the sources show no effect on warnings or on the public.
DP World reports that gate entry fell from three minutes to 15 seconds in live operations.
Greater worker safety is intended. Prevented injuries are unmeasured.
Lower congestion emissions and fewer harmful fires are intended, with no measured public outcome.
The office states the effects on case handling without figures or a cited source.
No count of fast-tracked cases from vulnerable groups, including women, is given.
Detection was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report gives no outcome of care for any patient.
The accuracy was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say whether the prompts changed any patient's care.

In SmartMore's model-training example, IndustryGPT achieved 100% accuracy and recall, against 50% accuracy and 66.7% recall for manual training, in less training time. Production revenue remains unmeasured.
The Busan Facilities Corporation pilot reportedly enabled recycling collection in previously unsorted public spaces and improved material separation.
Seoreu describes how the bin should help the environment and gives no measured change in emissions, pollution or ecosystems for the pilot.
The software's accuracy was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that its results guided any patient's care.

A drone observed that the man was asleep. By the department's own report, the robot then stood between him and the gun. The two-hour standoff ended in an arrest with no injury reported. No source shows that officers would otherwise have been hurt.

The passengers had been evacuated before the robot was used, and the man was taken into custody unharmed. The sources show no link between either outcome and the robot. By the reports, the man woke and left the bus.
The ministry describes the live service as giving immediate bilingual answers and document retrieval, a convenience that saves search time. No learning or financial outcomes are established.
The Ministry reports automation of routine inquiries and document handling, reducing manual effort. Monetary savings remain expected and unquantified.
The center describes pilots of ChatZOC across China, with no measured clinical or teaching improvement for the hospitals involved.

In their randomized trial, the makers report that medical students trained with the digital patient built on the ChatZOC framework scored 10.5 points higher in history taking. The comparison group was taught by usual methods, and no patient health result is reported.
Narrowing urban-rural gaps in eye care is an intended benefit with no measured result.

The Cour des comptes states in December 2025 that efficiency gains in control programming are established. It gives no measured gain in results attributable to data mining, and it reports that these controls accounted for 13.8% of the tax and penalties recovered in 2023.

The time saving was measured on stored images in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report gives no result from use after approval.
The case concerns the release of a dataset, and the sources name no beneficiary.
The Materials Project hosts the structures, and its team used 44,651 GNoME entries as a pool for screening. No independent report of a useful new material made from them appears in the sources.
No technology built on the predictions appears in the cited sources, and independent researchers dispute their novelty.
Unlawful shooting near a public street was interrupted and a charge filed, according to the police chief as quoted in the vendor's release.
No individual beneficiary or averted injury is documented.
The assessors found that the model allows rapid analysis of an average of 971 383 reports a year but gave no measure of the time saved.

The patient received a unifying genetic diagnosis at 44 for symptoms present since infancy, which led to screening for related complications. The authors write that he was diagnosed at a very advanced stage with a poor prognosis and that no specific treatment exists, so no change in his health is reported.
AI-assisted reads took 3 minutes and 50 seconds on average, against 33 minutes and 42 seconds, with diagnostic yield of 73.7% against 62.4%.
The study reports that the station's automatic captions fell below 98% in only 1/24 samples in 2020-2021, after reaching 98% in only 8/31 samples in 2019-2020.

Mathematicians gained an explicit cap set of size 512 in dimension 8 and an improved asymptotic bound. Davis, who was not an author, judged that the results are moderately interesting mathematically.
Forecasters who evaluated the model said that it increased their confidence in warning decisions and their lead time to severe hazards.
No source measures how much earlier the public was warned, and GAO says that more research is needed to quantify the effect on lead time.

Ramage, who is blind, now reads street signs, menus and scenes on his own and relies on the glasses each morning, which restores a capability that he had lost. He says that buses once drove past him at a stop and that the glasses bring a level of comfort that he had not had in years.
NOAA requested a voluntary speed reduction for an endangered species over a defined area for about 15 days. No source shows that a strike was averted or that vessels complied.

The evaluators found that the tool lets the department capture and digitally record road conditions and act on defects, on a pilot that the Bank's report sizes at 1000 km, while it covers only road condition data.

During the trial the Department of Transport and Main Roads had a working detector at one crossing. The developers report a recall of 0.97 and a precision of 0.77 during the on-road trial, and the department said that the equipment would be removed after the trial.

Drivers slowed by an average of 6.30 km/h and 5.06 km/h at two sites when the sign showed a warning. The department's claim of 31 percent fewer fatal crashes is not shown in the project summary, and a lower speed limit for roadwork may also have cut deaths.

Coates was critically ill, too sick for a transplant and facing hospice care. He reported that he began responding to the drugs within one or two weeks, later received a stem cell transplant and reached full remission five months after it. By his account, the treatment preserved his life. Neither Every Cure nor his treating physician has separated what the AI contributed from clinical judgment, the drugs, supportive care or the transplant.

Arbaugh reports computer control “just like anyone else can”. He still used the implant 28 months after surgery, and an earlier report puts his use at about 10 hours a day. Conley operates a robotic arm for light switches and doors.
No outcome for an organization is reported.
There were seven users in July 2025, and no effect across a population is reported.
ESTsoft reports that interviewed users in 10 centers described satisfaction, stress relief and a sense of belonging. It gives no measured change in health or cognition.
Neither ESTsoft nor Gimhae City reports a measured change in the work or service of the senior centers.
AIforPet reports pilot feasibility and user acceptance. No source quantifies an improvement in the management of horses.
Benefits to horse welfare and to sustainable livestock management remain potential.

In their own paper of October 2025, the makers state that the AI maps were still future work. The realized output is a field dataset with biomass from allometric equations. No AI benefit to conservation users is reported.
Restoration and carbon-market benefits are prospective effects of maps that had not been produced.
HSE University reports that its language-model pipeline built a database of 21,000 unique hazard events from 8.3 million articles, and that specialists checked the records.

Neither Huawei nor Huadian has published a measure of wider adoption of renewable power or lower emissions from this trial.
China Mobile reports that the monitored area grew from 120 to 330 square kilometers and that detection and enforcement efficiency improved by 45%.

China Mobile reports that wildlife distribution widened by 60% and that collision-related animal deaths fell by 97%. It gives no underlying counts and no causal controls.
China Telecom reports more than 900 million kWh in annual energy savings across its network. It also reports that deployment and operating costs for the energy system fell by 90%.
China Telecom reports a cut in CO₂ emissions of more than 500,000 tons. No independent check of the supporting calculations appears in the sources.
The research prototype is intended to improve the speed and coverage of monitoring, and no measured comparison has been reported.
Reduced conflict and better information integrity are goals. Neither outcome is documented.
The developer reports that the deployed agent outperformed human dispatchers in full control evaluations. The size of the improvement is not given.
More renewable energy and lower emissions are intended benefits, and the developer reports no measurement of either.

The authors report that controllers trained in simulation controlled plasma shape and position at DIII-D, with shape errors within 1.5 to 2.0 cm. This is a measured research capability, and commercial fusion output remains unestablished.
Reliable clean energy remains a future application, and delivered energy and climate benefits are unknown.

Participants use generative AI in practical tasks and custom GPT development. The organizers report no measured learning improvement caused by AI, and attendance and satisfaction describe the program as a whole.
Custom GPTs and AI-assisted research or knowledge products are intended to improve UN and civil-society work. No separate workplace productivity or quality improvement is measured.

The deployer reports a 183% rise in productivity and AED 246 million in annual budget savings as achieved. The establishment's figures have no independent confirmation in the sources.

SK Telecom reports that behavior-recording work fell from about three hours to five minutes per session. In June 2026 it reported that recording time fell by up to 90%.

No independent check of either figure appears in the sources, and they do not show the separate effect of the AI. SK Telecom has not reported injury severity or how long the improvement lasted.
The council reports time savings in administrative workflows and has not shown a lasting change in its services.
Staff report less repetitive administrative work and more time for other duties.
The council reports reduced routine-call demand and better routing, which amounts to a modest gain in efficiency.
The council reports no outcome for an individual officer or resident. It gives no response count or baseline for the thumbs-up feedback, and councillors report that some callers hung up without help.
Transport for West Midlands used the sensor observations to choose and build road-layout changes, which improved its ability to find and treat sites with many near misses.
Near misses at one Coventry junction fell from 17 to 2 over equal two-month periods after the refuge was built. Transport for West Midlands gives no data on collisions or injuries.
The vendor reports that AI use in the campaign cut cost per impression by 9% and cost per click by 5%, a cost saving with no reported effect on votes.
Reviewers at the vendor checked 2.7 million of the 208.4 million assessments that the AI made in 2024, a 98.7% cut in review work.
The audit counts fines, and it does not measure whether the cameras reduced crashes or injuries.
Reassessments from checks suggested by data mining at URSSAF Île-de-France rose from €3.7 million in 2023 to €33.5 million in 2024.
France Travail avoided about €5 million of contractor costs in 2024 and in 2025, by the Cour's estimate.
Country offices used the platform's insights in specific decisions, such as the 2024 flood response and changes to the HPV vaccine rollout in Nepal.
Interviewees said that programs became more tailored, but none of the initiatives collected outcome data.
Ancine analyzed 3,634 accountability reports in 2024 against 2,400 in the 16 years before, a measured gain in capacity.
The WWC found statistically significant reading gains, with improvement indexes of +1 to +4, across 79,084 students.

The evaluators found no evidence of incorrect discharge, but they had too little data to measure the effect of missed cancers or quality of life.
SNCF received 660 true intrusion alerts against 233 false ones, and the committee credits the tool with detecting people on the tracks more regularly.
The committee names risks to people and equipment that the tool prevents but counts only three interventions owed to it during the Olympics.
RATP received 1222 true intrusion alerts against 324 false ones and halved its intervention time from the alert, by the committee's account.
The committee reports no incident on the network that the faster response prevented.
In the Paralympic Games 55 detections led the command room to act, and the committee saw real value at sites too large to patrol.
The committee counts one intervention owed to the AI at Vaires-sur-Marne and reports no harm prevented.
Staff perceived savings of around an hour a day on three tasks, and around 65% of managers saw a productivity uplift. The savings are self-reported.
ISF found that about 74% of investigations started from risk-based selections led to action in 2024, against 40% of those started by public tips.
The reviewer gives no figure for delivery without the system, so the size of the reduction in skew cannot be established.
Readers' gains were measured on archived images in retrospective studies that AQuAS rated at high risk of selection bias.
In the studies that AETSA reviewed, ejection fractions from the four systems agreed with expert measurement, with usable nurse scans in 98.8% of cases in one study.
AETSA found no data on use of the systems in Europe and no long-term studies of their diagnostic validity.
Patients in the reviewed studies received better target coverage and, in most studies, lower doses to nearby organs, though no study reported tumor control, survival or long-term toxicity.
The auditor found that plate-reader matches led APD to 165 arrests and about 133 prosecutions from March to December 2024.
The audit counts the recovery of a missing or endangered person in the third quarter and gives no detail of the case.
The audit does not measure whether the arrests reduced crime in Austin.
The farmer's potato sales of more than $800 paid his children's school fees and, in his account, restored his family's income after the cyclone destroyed his harvest.
A ministry officer said that productivity is improving where farmers share the app, but no measurement is given.
Kansas City officers reached shots-fired alerts about two minutes sooner than citizen calls and stopped closer to the gunfire, and NIBIN evidence collection was 30.4% higher in the covered area.
Shootings and case clearance did not improve in either city, so no gain for residents is established.
Pedestrians and cyclists stand to gain, but Latin NCAP reports track tests with dummies and no crash outcomes.
The chairman says that in 2024 the network found more people than the squad's group of more than 200 volunteer reviewers, a gain in capability. He gives no counts.
The chairman says that the technology helped save a person in 2021 but gives no details, so the depth for people found cannot be established.
The FCC measured delay and accuracy on test calls and later found that both services met its minimum standards, but it reports no outcome for users.
The FCC certified the service on lab tests before it captioned incarcerated users' calls, and its later notice reports no outcome for users.

A family received a definitive molecular cause of their son's death. They used it for IVF with preimplantation genetic testing to avoid a recurrence of the lethal disease. The infant himself died at two days of life.
The predictions were made on archived records, and no clinician acted on the scores.
Primary care physicians aided by the device reached 91.4% sensitivity for skin cancer referral against 82.0% unaided.
The comparison used archived cases, and no patient was referred because of the software.
The patient regained active thumb and wrist movement that conventional rehabilitation had not produced. The gains are small, and pain did not consistently improve.
The authors report a single case with no follow-up and no use beyond the treating group, so no outcome for society is documented.
The review pooled accuracy from screening studies, and it reports no outcome of screening programs that used the software.
The FCC certified the app on lab tests before it captioned users' calls in the United States, and its later notices report no outcome for users.
The FCC certified the service on lab tests, and NexTalk had sought compensation for no calls by January 2025, so no outcome for users is reported.
NICE gives no size for the faster access to treatment and cannot say how much of it is due to the software.

The public learned which tool made the robocall, and the FCC later relied on Pindrop's analysis, with an NBC News report, for that fact in its proposed fine. No source shows that the analysis changed an outcome.

After 14 years of complete quadriplegia the patient regained the ability to drink and eat by himself through the glove that the interface drove. The authors of the preprint report neurological recovery: His upper-limb motor score rose by 5 points, and his score on the Action Research Arm Test rose by 27 points. He could also hold objects without the interface.

Silent, extensive, reversible ischemia from three-vessel disease was found and treated with quadruple bypass in an asymptomatic man. The authors' learning point is that such ischemia can end in exercise-induced sudden death. The counterfactual is not established.
Cytology teams reached 81.5% sensitivity for HSIL+ with the AI-selected images, against 74.0% by microscope.
The council reports less time spent writing case notes, assessments and supervision records.
Workers report less documentation effort and time. Improvements in service users’ health or care are unmeasured.
Staff report less time spent on meeting notes and other tasks.
Staff report improved focus, productivity and work experience. The duration of those improvements is unknown.

Caers reports that the AI-planned campaign appraised the high-grade zone of the deposit in about eight months, and the project then moved into development. Neither Caers nor KoBold quantifies how much of this result the AI produced.
ShotSpotter cut the median response time by 74 seconds against the rest of the city and brought police to 73 confirmed shootings that they knew about only through alerts.
The evaluators could not determine an effect on gunshot injuries, and they call it plausible but uncertain that a faster response saved one life.
The nurse survived a life-threatening hemorrhage and resumed her work and activities.
Nader, Farritor and Schilliger shared a $700,000 prize announced by the organizers on 5 February 2024. Farritor had earlier won the First Letters prize for the first word.
The readable text bore out the program at the University of Kentucky that developed virtual unwrapping, which Seales called a 20-year dream.
A previously unknown Greek philosophical text became readable. Reporters at Nature wrote that the method opens the way to reading the rest of the scrolls.
Referrals rose 15% in services using the chatbot against 6% in control services, with rises of 179% for nonbinary people and 29% for ethnic minority people.
FDA counts 10 previously undiagnosed participants as helped but reports no follow-up of their care.
The department counts train stops and crossings. It has published no count of injuries that crews or passengers avoided.
The Forest Department reports no elephant deaths as of July 2026 on a stretch that recorded eleven deaths from 2008 to 2022, including three in November 2021.

The department reports about 9,481 safe crossings and no track deaths for wild elephants as of July 2026 on a stretch that recorded eleven deaths from 2008 to 2022. The number of deaths that would otherwise have occurred remains unknown. A train killed two elephants near Puthuppathi on 13 August 2026.
Farmers did not receive the chatbot's answers, so no change in their practices or yields is reported.
The council reports that the job-advert tool saves drafting time and makes adverts uniform.
Managers report that they spend less time drafting job postings. The council has not measured what happened to applicants or to hiring.
Doctors read stored images in the maker's pre-market trial, and no patient's care depended on the software.
HKO found an edge for the AI models in track forecasts for eight cyclones in 2023, and an AI model correctly foresaw that a predicted cyclone would not form.
Averaged over all lead times, Pangu-Weather's track error was 140.8 against 169.7 for ECMWF's model in CMA's 2023 verification.
The council reports that selected data-retrieval tasks took 90% less time and cost in the pilot than in the existing system. Savings across deployed services are unmeasured.
The council reports a test result for tasks and no outcome for any social worker, child or family, and no gain in child safety has been shown.
The robot repaired a small number of cracks in the public-road pilot, a new operational capability.
Fewer potholes and injuries and less dangerous roadwork for crews are intended, and no safety benefit has been reported.
SES Water reports that leak run times fell by up to 40%, and Haskoning ties the 40% figure to critical burst mains. Both figures come from the utility and its vendor.

People with mobility or sensory impairments are meant to gain safe, independent travel, and no outcome for a real user is documented.

Te Hiku Media built a transcription tool for te reo Māori and reports its accuracy at 92%, up from 86% in its first model. Participants completed small daily identifications without asking family. They rated descriptions 2.76/5 for satisfaction and 2.43/4 for trust on average. The app could not read text.
The ministry recognized higher diagnostic accuracy for specialists using the program, and a trade journal reported a rise in their tumor detection rate from 21.6% to 31.2%.
The app launched across federal entities, and no measured improvement in human-resources processes has been reported.
Better experience and access for employees are intended effects of the app, and the authority that built it has reported no measure of them.
In the pooled trials, adenomas were found in 44.3% of people examined with CADe against 37.1% with standard colonoscopy.

By his own account, the owner reached a VA emergency room during an insulin-pump failure with blood glucose at 670. He says that he was treated for a mild heart attack and left the hospital with no restrictions, so a serious condition was treated in time. No clinician, hospital or official has confirmed the emergency or the drive.
The risk categories were measured on retrospective data, and no hospital used the score to change care.
The accuracy figures come from archived x-rays, and no patient was referred because of the software.
Crowdworks AI reports that real-world tests using 1.05 million data samples showed over 90% translation accuracy.
Crowdworks AI reports over 90% user satisfaction in field tests in more than 20 languages. No source measures injury prevention.
A stage I colorectal cancer inside a 1 to 1.5 cm adenoma was removed through the endoscope without surgery, according to all three reports. No survival benefit for this early cancer has been shown.
The forecasts were run after the storm for comparison, and no forecaster used them in warnings.

PTI reports only that police “prevented a possible suicide by a student hailing from the Jhunjhunu district” within a week of the launch. Neither PTI nor the police have described what the student posted, the student's condition when reached or what officers did, so the outcome is not established.
The computerized review closed 149 accountability reports and 20 older agreements without a detailed financial review, a saving of staff time that the TCU did not measure.
The qualification allows future use in ablation device trials, and no trial using the tool is reported.
In HTW's pooled analysis, pathologists' sensitivity for cancer rose from 91.6% to 96% with AI help, while specificity did not change.
UNOSAT reports that analysts did not need to correct 86 percent of the images that Flood AI processed.
The evaluation does not report whether the flood maps reached responders sooner or changed any response.
Every participant also had a colonoscopy, so the test changed no screening decision in the study.
AgileSoDA reports 76% less floor-planning time, from more than a week to roughly a day, across partner deployments.
Higher-value work and professional development for engineers are expected consequences, and the sources include no measure of them.
Patients imaged themselves at home in the study, and FDA states that it has not been demonstrated whether the benefits will result in improved visual outcomes.

Students of tutors with the tool were 4 percentage points more likely to pass session exit tickets (62% to 66%), and 9 points for lower-rated tutors. The authors found no significant gain on end-of-year tests.
The provider's tutors with the tool prompted students to explain more often and gave generic praise less often, at about $20 per tutor per year.
Two county lines dealers were convicted, according to the force and the court outcome. Officers seized 99 wraps of crack cocaine and two knives.
The accuracy figures come from validation studies, and no practice is reported to have changed treatment because of the output.
Farmers are meant to make better planting decisions, and the team reports no farmer who used the system.
Agricultural agencies are meant to obtain local environmental data.
Climate adaptation is intended, and no field outcome can be attributed to the system.
The bureau approved the shuttle for service with no driver, and no outcome for riders or for the town's bus service is reported.

Treated students scored 0.31 standard deviations higher on the whole test and 0.23 higher in English after six weeks. This is a measured gain in test scores. Independent authors who re-analyzed the trial put the effect on the whole test at 0.310 standard deviation (95% confidence interval 0.176 to 0.444).
The 1.5 to 2 years of business-as-usual schooling is a cost-effectiveness comparison made by the authors. They do not report a change in the schools themselves.
Ant reports that an annotation system that it developed with specialist doctors improved annotation efficiency by 50%. No clinical outcome is reported.

Ant names healthcare equity and rural access as aims. The sources contain no measure of a change in how care is distributed.
The partnership's counts show 849 offenses detected in two weeks of camera use.
The report gives no casualty or behavior figures for the area.
In a 12-week study in Germany, Kaia users improved in pain beyond the minimal clinically important difference, while people in standard care did not.
The study compares forecast skill on past periods and reports no realized gain for ECMWF or for any user of the forecasts.

Patients on 60 mg once a day gained a mean 98.4 mL in forced vital capacity over 12 weeks. Patients on placebo lost 20.3 mL. It is a measured improvement in a test of lung function, and it was a secondary endpoint of a small trial. Three patients on 60 mg and one on placebo had an acute exacerbation. Insilico has not reported a lasting change in any patient's disease.

A wider benefit would need confirmation in larger and longer trials, and the authors call for them. Insilico gave the first dose of the phase 3 trial in September 2026, and the trial has no results yet.
The accuracy was measured in the maker's pre-market trial, and the report does not say that the software's prompts guided any patient's care.

The fire was held to three acres after helicopters were dispatched within 30 minutes. CORE's CEO called the detection and location “crucial”. The Forest Service spotted the fire at the same time, which limits what can be credited to the cameras.

Xcel Energy and CORE Electric have not reported an outcome of their own, such as damage avoided to their lines or equipment. The alert served the response of the county and the Forest Service. The claim that alerts typically beat 911 calls is about the system in general.
No individual who benefited is documented.
No reader is known to have found resources faster or better with AI.
The Guild has not reported launching the librarian or measuring a gain from it.
CATARC measured the system in its tests, and no crash outcome for drivers or passengers is reported.
The screens produced new sigma-2 and 5-HT2A ligands at hit rates equal to those from experimental structures (54% and 26%).
The program detected more cat images and sequences than staff did (67 of 68 sequences against 57), with an estimated A$2.15 million saved with 4G cameras.
HALO states that its AI models analyze terrain in hours where manual assessment took days. That is a time saving for HALO's analysts, and HALO gives no measured figure.
No cleared hectare, found mine or avoided casualty in Ukraine is linked to the AI analysis in the sources.
Cultural literacy and understanding are intended, and no improvement in learning or access has been measured.

Cultural preservation and representation are intended benefits, and no preservation result has been shown.
DeepMind evaluated its systems on the 2024 olympiad problems. DeepMind has not reported a deployment or a change in an organization.

Two graders marked the proofs of contest problems that already had solutions, and no beneficiary beyond the research community is named. Scientific American notes that around 60 students scored better in 2024.

The detection results do not show how much loss or other harm users avoided.
No measured effect on the safety of the information environment appears in the sources.
The council reports that automation has begun to simplify workflows and reduce administrative work.

Scribe users spent 15.9% less time in notes and 8.5% less time in the EHR per appointment.
Students in the ChatGPT-4 group scored 22.8 against 19.24 on the acute abdomen post-test, a moderate effect (Cohen's d = 0.58).
Teachers saved about 25.3 minutes a week on Year 7 and 8 science lesson preparation.
Schools gained teacher time with no difference found in the quality of resources.
Professionals with AI spent 16.4% less time and reported more positive emotions.
Individuals with AI produced solutions rated 0.37 SD higher, on par with teams without AI.
A father and his daughter received a genetic diagnosis of long QT syndrome and preventive beta-blocker treatment against sudden arrhythmic death. No cardiac event was imminent.
Cal Fire's command center in Grass Valley sent engines when the alert came in. Crews put the fire out before it spread beyond a 30 x 30 foot area, so a larger fire at night was avoided.
People living near Auburn gained from a fire that crews put out before it spread. Cal Fire has not estimated the damage that the fire would otherwise have done.

A fire next to a residential neighborhood was kept to one-eighth of an acre. The sources name no beneficiary.

The smartwatch trace led to a diagnosis of ventricular tachycardia and to an implantable defibrillator, which later shocked him for ventricular tachycardia with episodes degenerating into ventricular fibrillation. One asymptomatic man had a low PVC burden (1.75%) characterized, judged benign, and managed with lifestyle change. No drug or procedure is documented. The authors are inconsistent about how far the ring prompted the work-up.
Doctors read stored images in the maker's pre-market trial, and no patient's care depended on the software.

Every participant also had a colonoscopy, so the test changed no screening decision in the study.
A teacher adapted and translated a task for a student with autism in seconds, by the department's account, and the committee reports no outcome for the student.

The report does not say that the prompts guided care in the maker's pre-market trial.
The AlphaFold screen found 18 new TAAR1 agonists and a lead with antipsychotic-like effects in mice.

Doctors read stored images in the maker's pre-market trial, and no patient's care depended on the software.
No single person can be named as a beneficiary.
The comptroller attributes almost R$100 million of the cut in one tender's reference value to its findings, an amount material to the federal budget.

By his own account a CT the next day showed an appendix close to rupturing and surgeons removed it that day, so the sources report a serious condition resolved in time, though only on his word.

The fire service learned of the crash at 11:04, about 46 minutes before the operator reported the helicopter missing, and the call came from the crater area. No source shows that the head start changed the search, since the helicopter's GPS track also ended near the crater.

Staff reported clearer, more consistent and more efficient assessments and records, with no measure given.
